Uvegin da, chakkimin deyadin razin, bayayn lesaddera shimmusha dilhon, behay lelya. may taama. begin dechol yome deshabbeta, it lon rucha achara deshara al alma, uvehay lelya it lon rucha achara kaddisha illaa, denachta livni kaddishin, vehahu rucha nashiv meattika dechol attikin, venachta lego nekuda tattaa, lemehav bah nayycha lecholla, veda itpelig lechol sitrin, leella vetatta, kema deat amar beni uven bene yisrael.

Vechad innun chakkimin, yatvin behahu rucha kaddisha, rucha illaa, baan leshammesha arsayyhu, dehay rucha amshich avatreh letatta, kol innun nishmatin kaddishin, veyartin kaddishe elyonin, behay rucha, nishmatin kaddishin livnehon kedka yeot.
Zohar, Vayigash 10: Vehakkol nishma bet paro. ribbi (elazar) abba patach veamar, (Tehillim 84:3) nichsefa vegam kalta nafshi lechatzrot Adonai libbi uvesari yerannenu el el chay. ta chaze, kol bar nash detzalle tzeloteh (vekam) kamme mareh, itzterich leh leakdama leh birchan bechol yoma veyoma, uletzalle tzeloteh kamme mareh bezimna deitzterich.

Betzafra, leachada bimina dekudesha berich hu. bemincha, leachada bismala. utzelota uvauta, itzterich leh levar nash bechol yoma veyoma begin leitachada beh. veokimna, man detzalle tzeloteh, (vekam) kamme mareh, itzterich leh dela lemishma kaleh bitzloteh. uman deashma kaleh bitzloteh, tzeloteh la ishtema.

May tama. begin (Shemot 202 amud bet) ditzlota, lav ihi hahi kala deishtema. dehahu kol deishtamma lav hi tzelota. uman ihi tzelota. da kala ochora, detalya bekala deishtema, uman hu kala deishtema. da hahu kol dehu beVav, kala detalya beh, da hahu kol bela vav.

Uvegin kach, la itzterich leh levar nash lemishma kaleh bitzloteh, ella letzallaa belachash, behahu kala dela ishtema. veda hi tzelota deitkabbalat tadir. vesimanich, vehakkol nishma, kol bela vav, nishma. da hi tzelota dehi bachashay. dichtiv bechanna, (Shmuel 1 1:13) vekolah lo yishshama. da hi tzelota dekudesha berich hu kabbil, kad itavid go reuta vechavvavna vetikkuna kedka yeut, uleyachada yichuda demareh kedka yaot bechol yoma. (vehakkol nishma bet paro. vehakkol nishma chaser vav, may tama, amar rabbi elazar, da hi shechinta debachat al charuv bi makdesha veal galutehon deyisrael. ketiv hacha, vehakkol nishma, uchetiv hatam, (Yirmeyahu 31:15) kol barama nishma. ma lehallan shechinta, af kan name shechinta).
Ribbi elazar amar, kala bachashay, da hi kala illaa, dechol kalin nafkin mittamman. aval kol bela 6, da hi tzelota diltatta, deihi azla leistalleka beVav uleitchabbera beh.

Ta chaze, vehakkol nishma, da hu kol bela vav. da hi kala debachat al mikdash rishon veal mikdash sheni. nishma, kema deat amer, kol berama nishma. berama, may berama. da hu alma illaa, alma deate. vesimanich, min harama vead bet el, (Tehillim 106:48) min haolam vead haolam. hacha berama, da alma illaa. deha behahi shata di berama nishma. keden ma ketiv, (Yeshayahu 22:12) vayyikra Adonai elohim tzevaot bayyom hahu livchi ulemisped vegomer.

Vehakkol nishma, leela leela. may tama. begin devv itrachak veistallak minneh, ucheden rachel mevakka al baneha meana lehinnachem al baneha ki enenu. ki enennu, ki enam mibbae leh. ella ki enennu, veha okimna, ki enennu, devaalah la ishtakkach immah. deillemale baalah yishtakkach immah, titnachem alayyhu. deha keden benaha, la yehon begaluta. uvegin deenennu, lav ihi mitnachama al benaha, begin divnaha itrachaku minnah, al deenennu immah.

Ta chaze, bet paro, da hu simanich leela, beta deitperau veitgalleyayn minneh kol nehorin vechol butzinin, kol ma dehava satim, mittamman itgeli. uvegin kach, kudesha berich hu appik kol nehorin vechol butzinin, begin leanhara lehahu kol, deikre kol bela vav.

Ta chaze, kad yakim kudesha berich hu lehay kol meafra, veyitchabbar beVav, keden kol ma deitavid minnayyhu bezimna degaluta, yithadar veyitaddenun binhorin illain deittosfan miggo alma illaa. kema deat amer, (Yeshayahu 27:13) vehaya bayyom hahu yittaka beshofar gadol uvau haovdim beeretz ashshur vehanniddachim beeretz mitzrayim vehishtachavu laAdonai behar hakkodesh birushalam:
Zohar, Vayigash 11: Veatta tzuvveta zot asu kechu lachem meeretz mitzrayim vegomer. ribbi chiyyay patach, (Yeshayahu 66:10) simchu et yerushalam vegilu vah kol ohaveha sisu ittah masos vegomer. ta chaze, kad itcharav be makdesha vegarmu chovin, veitgalu yisrael meara, (Vayikra 75 amud alef) istallak kudesha berich hu leela leela, vela ashgach al charuv be makdesha, veal ammeh deitgalu, ucheden shechinta itgalleyay immehon.

Kad nachat, ashgach al beteh deittokad, istakkal al ammeh veha itgeli. shaal al matronita veittarchat. keden vayyikra Adonai elohim tzevaot bayyom hahu livchi ulemisped ulekarecha velachagor sak. vehi gam hi ma ketiv bah, (Yoel 1:8) eli kivtula chagurat sak al baal neureha. kema deat amer ki enennu, begin deistallak minah, veishtakkach piruda.

Veafillu shemaya veara, kullehu itabbalu, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 50:3) albish shamayim kadrut vesak asim kesutam. malache illae kullehu itabbalu aleh, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 33:7) hen erellam tzaaku chutztza malache shalom mar yivkayun. shimsha vesihara itabbalu vechashchu nehorehon. dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 13:10) chashach hashshemesh betzeto vegomer, vecholla illae vetattae, bachu alah veitabbalu. may tama, begin deshalta alah sitra ochora, deshalta al ara kaddisha.

Patach veamar, (yechezkel 7:2) veatta ben adam ko amar Adonai elohim leadmat yisrael ketz ba hakketz al arba kanfot haaretz. hay kera raza illaa ihu. leadmat yisrael ketz, may ihu. vechi admat yisrael ketz hi. ella hachi hu vadday veittemar, ketz ihu limina, ketz ihu lismala. ketz limina, dichtiv, (Daniel 12) leketz hayyamin. ketz lismala, dichtiv, (iyyov 28:3) ketz sam lachoshech ulechol tachlit hu choker, veda hu (Bereshit 6:13) ketz kol basar, kema deittemar.

Ketz dimina, hayeynu dichtiv leadmat yisrael ketz. ba hakketz, da ketz dismala. ketz dimina, da ketz deyetzer hattov. ketz dismala, da ketz deyetzer hara, veda ihu dechad chovin garmu veitgabberu, itgezar veityeyhiv shaltana lemalchut harshaa leshaltaa, ulecharava beteh umikdesheh. veda hu dichtiv, (yechezkel 7:Adonai) ko amar Adonai elohim raa achar raa hinne vaa, vecholla chad.

Uvegin kach, itabbalu illae vetattae al deityeyhiv shaltano lehay ketz dismala. uvegin kach, kevan demalchu kaddisha, malchut shamayim itkafya, umalchut chayyayva (achara) itgabbar. (keden) it leh lechol bar nash, leitabbala immah, uleitkafya immah. uvegin dechad ihi yizdakkefa, vealma yitchadde, yitchadde ihu bahadah. dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 66:10) sisu ittah masos kol hammitabbelim aleha.

Ta chaze, ketiv behu bemitzrayim, (yirmeya 46) egla yefifiya mitzrayim. veraza deegla da, havu yisrael techot shaltaneh kamma zimnin vechamma shenin. uvegin dizminin yisrael leshalletaa levatar alah, itremiz lon hasheta agalot.

Ribbi elazar amar, remez ramaz leh yosef leyaakov al egla arufa. deha behahu pirka itperash minneh. veukemuha, egla arufa, deihi atya al deishtakkach katola, vela ityeyda man katil leh. uvegin dela yishletun al ara ruchin bishin dela itzterichu, yahavin hay egla letikkuna, begin dela yishtemodun legabbeh, vela yishletu alayyhu. (leel 114 amud alef)
Ta chaze, kol bene nasha kullehu avrin al yede demalach hammavet, bar mehay deakdimu leh bene nasha, ad la yimte zimna leshalletaa beh velitol reshu. deha la shallit bevar nash, ad denatil reshu.

Uvegin kach, it leh dina leshalletaa al hahu atar. kema deat amer, (Devarim 21:1) lo noda mi hikkahu. hachi name it leh dina dela ityeyda, begin lekatrega al hahu atar. veal da, (Devarim 21:3) velakchu zikne hair hahi eglat bakar vegomer. begin leaavara dineh dehahu atar, uleittakkana dela yishlot beh mekatrega, uleishtezava minneh.

Ta chaze, yosef kad itperash meavoy, bela levaya, uvela achila ishtaddar, vehava ma dehava. vechad amar yaakov, (Bereshit 37:35) tarof toraf yosef, amar, ki ered el beni avel sheola, deana garimna leh. vetu, dahavena yada daachoy sanyayn leh, veshaddarna leh. veremez ka ramiz leh.

Amar leh ribbi yehuda, inun agalot al pi paro shaddar lon, dichtiv vayyitten lahem yosef agalot al pi paro. amar leh, diyyuka demilla, dichtiv veatta tzuvveta zot asu. veatta tzuvveta dayyka, uvegin kach ketiv beHei, mashma deyosef tava lon, uvegin kach vayyitten lahem yosef agalot al pi paro. veyaakov la itkeyyaym bemilla, ad dechama lon. dichtiv, vayyar et haagalot asher shalach yosef laset oto vattechi ruach yaakov avihem.

Amar rabbi shimon, bekadmita vattechi ruach yaakov, ulevatar vayyomer yisrael rav od yosef beni chay. ella, bekadmita kare leh orayyta yaakov, begin shuttafuta, deishtattefu shechinta behahu cherem, kad izdabban yosef. vehasheta dishchinta salka, keden ihu, vattechi ruach yaakov avihem, veda hu raza dishchinta. uvatar deihi kayyma bekiyyuma, (begin) keden darga dilela, itavar legabbah, darga deihu yisrael. (nusach acher keden darga dilella, ittear legabbah, veihu darga deyisrael) mikkan, dedarga dilela la itar leela, ad deitar bekadmita letatta, deha hacha vattechi ruach yaakov bekadmita, ulevatar vayyomer yisrael.

Vayyomer elohim leyisrael bemarot hallayla, bemarat ketiv. ta chaze, vayyizbach zevachim lelohe aviv yitzchak, bekadmita. begin leitara semala beraza dirchimu. ucheden vayyomer elohim leyisrael bemarot hallayla, behay darga dekaamaran deihi marot hallayla.

Vayyomer anochi hael elohe avicha, may tama. begin desitra dikdushsha dilela, hachi hu. deha sitra dimsaava, la adkar shema dekudesha berich hu, vechol setar dikdushsha idkar bishmeh. anochi ered immecha mitzrayma vegomer, mikkan, dishchinta nachatat immeh begaluta, uvechol atar deyisrael itgalu, shechinta itgalleya immehon, veha ukemuha.

Ta chaze, kamma agalot havu. shit. kema deat amer, (Bamidbar 6) shesh eglot tzav. davar acher, shittin havu, vecholla raza chada. bekadmita ketiv baagalot asher shalach yosef, ulevassof asher shalach paro. ella, kullehu deshaddar yosef, havu bechushebana kedka chaze. veinun deshaddar paro yattir minnayyhu, la havu beraza da, vela havu bechushebana.

Veillen veillen kaatu. begin kach, asher shalach yosef, asher shalach paro. vechad yifkun yisrael min galuta ma ketiv, (Yeshayahu 66:20) veheviu et kol achechem mikkol haggoyim mincha laAdonai vegomer:

rashi: Veatta. af al pi shehaya roe shellifne hakkadosh baruch hu kashe, lo nimna millehallom kol petacheha vechol sheareha yachad:

Bechashshil vechelappot. kele mashchit shel naggarim hem, "uvekardummot bau lah" (Yirmeyahu 46:22) targum yonatan "bechashilayya". kelappot leshon aravi hu, kach peresh donash, vehu mikkele hannaggarim:
Yahalomun. haoyvim:
targum: Ucheden gelifyaha garrin kachada bekufitz uvemafselat deyusetar mochoyan bemarzofin:

ohc: Hen henna vegomer bidvar bilam. tzarich ladaat kavvanat amro hen henna, od lamma heerich lomar "bidvar bilam vegomer al devar peor", veyitbaer haddavar behair lamma shaggu pinchas vetzaddike elyon shehalchu immo bedavar ze.

Achen pinchas veanshe hatztzava danu ufetarum mittaam shehannashim kefufot hen levaalehen velaavotehen vaanusim hemma, vehen haadon moshe rabbenu alav hashshalom hirgish shemmittaam ze hecheyu otam uva betaana hannishmaat veamar: bishlama im lo hayu osim ella maase hazzenut shebba lahem alav mitzvat gedolehem yesh ladun otam lizchut, ella shehem asu meatzman maase acher ma shello tziuu otam gedolehem, shehu maase peor, sheamru razal (Bamidbar Rabba 20,23) shehayu motziim lahem tzurat peor veomrim lahem: hishtachave laze vetihye nishmaat lo. nimtza shemmichshol avoda zara haya mehem. vehu amro hen henna, perush, middenafsham hayu sibba livne yisrael. bidvar bilam vegomer, perush, beemtzaut sibbat atzat bilam sheyyeatzam lehafekir benotehem liznut. vetimtza shello amru zichrono livracha sheamar bilam ella inyan hazzenut, keamram (sham): elohehen shel ellu sone zimma vechulei, vehem hayu sibba limsor maal baAdonai al devar peor, shello hayu rotzim lehishshama lahem ella im yishtachavu lifor. vattehi hammaggefa baadat Adonai, perush, besibbat avoda zara velo besibbat hazzenut, umi garam avoda zara – hen henna. veomer "veatta" vegomer, perush, yitvaddu al hashshegaga veyahargu kol vegomer.

Vaydabber Adonai vegomer lemor nekom vegomer. kashe, im haddibbur ba lemor leyisrael kannishma mittevat "lemor", haya lo lomar "nikmu nikmatchem meet" vegomer. uvemidrash tanchuma amru veze leshonam: en vaydabber ella leshon az vechulei, hitchil moshe lefayyes hakkadosh baruch hu al mitato velo nitpayyes vechulei, amar lo moshe: li rauy mita sheraiti niflaot vechulei, ufiyyeso Adonai bishne devarim: im atta rotze lichyot shanim rabbot lo yiru yisrael bemappelet oyvehem velo tikkavesh midyan lifnehem vechulei, vechevan shennitpayyes moshe haya kashe lifne hakkadosh baruch hu shekkanas alav mita vechulei, ad kan. hinne baal hammidrash hirgish bema sheddikdaknu velidvarav yityashshev hakkatuv al nachon. "vaydabber" leshon koshi, ze yirmoz lishne mine koshi: echad lemoshe al mitato, veechad beene Adonai al shekkanas al yedido hammita. vetevat lemor nitkavven lirmoz el happiyyus sheppiyyes Adonai lemoshe lehitpayyes lamut mittaam "nekom" vegomer kaamur bammidrash. o yirtze betevat lemor lehodia ritztzuy sheritztza moshe laAdonai kede shello yamut, veanahu Adonai "nekom" vegomer perush, bishvil sheyyinkom meoyve yisrael.

Ulefi peshat hakkatuv yitbaer al ze hadderech: "vaydabber Adonai" – amar leshon dibbur, lomar dibber elav devar melech shilton kishar kol hatztziuuyim shebbattora. veamro lemor kifshatah – lemor leyisrael kechol "lemor" haamura battora, vechan tzericha leamer yoter mikkol hammekomot, lefi sheamar "nekom" tavo lo hassevara shehu levad yaase hannekama kifshat hammaamar, veen ze davar zar ki gibbor chayil haya vaAdonai beezro. vetze ulemad mihonatan ben shaul vegomer (Shmuel 1 14), umikkol shekken moshe gibbor haggibborim. laze amar elav lemor leyisrael. veamro nekom vegomer, perush: lefi shettala lo Adonai mitato benikmat midyan, dichtiv "achar teasef" vegomer, amar elav ki bema sheyyomar haddevarim hu lahem, baze maale alav hakkatuv shehu hannokem, ki hu moser nafsho mammash al haddavar, shehagam sheyyodea shebbeemtzaut ken yamut, af al pi chen yomar leyisrael ma sheamar besamuch. en lecha kiyyum mitzvat "bechol nafshecha" kazo, uvesamuch yitbaer beofen acher.

Veshama aviha et nidrah vegomer vekamu kol nedareha vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma hitchil ledabber leshon yachid, keamro "nidrah", vegamar omer leshon rabbim, keamro "nedareha". gam ma merabbe betevot "kol nedareha" vechol issar", shello haya lo lomar ella "vekamu nedareha vaasareha". od lamma shinna bannedarim amar vekamu nedareha uvaasarim yakum. gam lo haya tzarich lomar "yakum" vehaya somech al maamar "vekamu" sheamar battechilla.

Veyitbaer hakkatuv al pi ma sheamru bemassechet nedarim daf paz veze leshon hammishna: amra "konam teenim vaanavim", kiyyem latteenim – kullo kayyam, hefer latteenim – eno mufar ad sheyyafer gam laanavim. amra "konam anavim sheeni toemet uteenim sheeni toemet" – hare ellu shene nedarim, ad kan. veamru bashshas veze leshonam: matnitin rabbi yishmael hi, detanya "ishah yekimennu", amra "konam teenim vaanavim" vechulei, kiyyem latteenim – kullo kayyam vechulei, hefer laanavim – eno mufar ad sheyyafer gam latteenim, divre rabbi yishmael. rabbi akiva omer: hare hu omer "ishah yekimennu" vegomer, ma yekimennu mimmennu af yefirennu mimmennu. verabbi yishmael: mi ketiv yafer mimmennu? verabbi akiva: makkish hafara lahakama. amar rabbi yochanan: zo divre rabbi yishmael verabbi akiva, aval chachamim omrim: makkish hakama lahafara, ma hafara ma shehefer hefer, af hakama ma shekkiyyem kiyyem, ad kan. zo hi girsat hassefarim shellefanenu, aval hattosafot veramban veharan gorsim: aval chachamim omrim ma hafara ma shehefer lo hufar af vechulei, ulefi girsa zo chachamim verabbi yishmael hem bisvara achat beinyan hahafara shello hufar, vegirsa zo hi ikkar kemo shehochichu mehattosefta.

Nimtzenu omrim shalosh sevarot: 1 hi sevarat rabbi yishmael shehevi rabbi bammishna, sheim hekim chelek mehanneder hekim hakkol, veim hefer chelek mehanneder eno mufar afillu chelek shehefer. 2 sevarat rabbi akiva shekkol shehekim miktzat o hefer miktzat keillu hekim o hefer hakkol. 3 sevarat chachamim shessovrim shebben bahafara ben bahakama en hakamato vahafarato kelum ella im hekim o hefer hakkol. ulechol echad mishshelosh hassevarot yityashshev hakkatuv al nachon.

Lisvarat rabbi yishmael shessatam rabbi bammishna kemoto, yityashshev al ze hadderech amro "veshama aviha et nidrah" leshon yachid, lomar shebbenoderet neder echad hakkatuv medabber, uchegon sheamra "konam teenim vaanavim", shezze yikkare neder echad, leappoke im amra "konam teenim sheeni toemet, konam anavim" vechulei, shezze yikkare shene nedarim.

Veamro vehecherish vegomer vekamu kol nedareha, perush: afillu lo hecherish ella mipperat echad, perush shemmehatteenim vehaanavim shennadra bahem lo hecherish ella latteenim, "vekamu kol nedareha", perush afillu laanavim. uvaze heircha ki amro vehecherish en hakkavvana mehakkol, shehare hutzrach lehodiacha bakkiyyum veamar vekamu kol, ha lamadta shead atta bemaamar vehecherish lo hayinu asukim lechol nedareha.

Veamro vechol issar vegomer yakum, nitkavven beshinnuy ze lehazekiro bilshon yachid, legallot shemmaamar "kol nedareha" lo shehem nedarim rabbim, ella neder echad hu, ella shekkalla bo devarim rabbim – teenim vaanavim, uveerech hanniddarim hu sheamar leshon rabbim, vehu amro "vechol issar vegomer yakum". vahagam shehammaamar ba beissar, kevar hodiacha hakkatuv sheddin hanneder vehashshevua shavim.

Veamro yakum – velo samach al maamar "vekamu" shekkadam, sheim ken hayiti mefaresh kavvanat hakkatuv shebba lomar sheim nadra venishbea al shene devarim yachad vehecherish lanneder, kiyyem gam lashshevua, laze amar "yakum" lomar shetztzarich hakama lechol echad mehem.

Veamro veim heni vegomer kol nedareha, perush, tzarich sheyyafer kol nedareha, perush – im lo hefer ella latteenim eno mufar ad sheyyafer gam laanavim. veamro lo yakum leshon yachid, lehaircha shebbeneder echad hakkatuv medabber, leval tite mimmaamar "nedareha" vegomer, sheen hakkatuv medabber ella benoderet nedarim rabbim kaddin haamur bassefa shel hammishna shekkatavnu lemala (nedarim 66:).

Velisvarat rabbi akiva shebbahafarat chelek hufar hakkol uvahakamat chelek kemo chen hukam hakkol, yitbaer al ze hadderech: veshama aviha et nidrah vegomer vehecherish vegomer, perush – im shama afillu chelek minnidrah, hagam shello shama kol nidrah vehecherish leoto chelek, baze vekamu kol nedareha afillu chelek shello shama. veamro veim heni aviha otah, perush – afillu lo heni hakkol ella chelek echad, kol sheanu korin bo "heni otah". velaze lo hismich maamar "kol nedareha" lemaamar "veim heni" al ze hadderech: "veim heni aviha kol nedareha beyom shamo", veaz lo haya tzarich lomar tevat "otah". uchefi ze, maamar "kol nedareha" vegomer nimshach lematta lemaamar "lo yakum". veamar lo yakum leshon yachid, nitkavven baze lomar chiddush haddin sheafillu ma shello hefer hufar.

Ulederech ze yityashshev al nachon maamar vaAdonai yislach lah vegomer, perush, sheim lo heni aviha ella laanavim vehi enah yodaat hammishpat sheggam latteenim hoil habbittul veachla teenim, modia hakkatuv she yislach lah, ki tzericha selicha kevan shelledatah lo heni al hatteenim. venatan taam hasselicha "ki heni aviha otah", perush, ki habbittul sheasa aviha hoil gam laze. vehutzrach lomar ken lehaircha shehaddavar shealav ba hasselicha hu al heder yedia zo shemmimmenna yatza hashshegaga, vehaven.

Velisvarat chachamim sheamru shello toil hafara lemiktzat velo hakama lemiktzat, ad sheyyafer lakkol o yakum lakkol, yitbaer al ze hadderech: "veshama aviha et nidrah" – amar leshon yachid lehaircha shehakkatuv medabber beasta neder echad, velo beasta shene nedarim, kemo shepperashti lisvarat rabbi yishmael. veamro vehecherish vegomer vekamu kol nedareha – maamar "kol nedareha" nimshach lefanav velifne fanav, veze perusho: "vehecherish lah aviha" – ematay yoil hacharisha lehakim? im yihyu "kol nedareha", aval chelek mimmenna lo toil lo hakama.

Veamro veim heni vegomer kol nedareha vegomer, maamar "kol nedareha" nimshach lemala al ze hadderech: veim heni vegomer – im bahafarato heni hakkol, az lo yakum perat mehem. ulehodiacha ba sheim heni perat echad en anu korim bo "lo yakum". vahagam shennomar shemmaamar "kol nedareha" nimshach lematta lemaamar "lo yakum", yitbaer al ze hadderech: "kol nedareha" vegomer "lo yakum" – perush, bizman sheyyesh kol nedareha bichlal, az yeshno lapperat. ha lamadta sheen bittul lapperat levaddo. vechol ze davka sheasta neder echad, kemo sherasham bemaamar "veshama aviha et nidrah", aval im asta otam begeder shene nedarim, en nitle ze baze.

rashi: Af zanachta vattachlimenu. af im atta tachlimenu anu shimcha leolam node:
targum: Lechod ashleta veachsaftana vela tashre shechintach bechelvana:

ohc: Kol keli maase. hodia baze ribbuy hashshalal shel midyan levad haya shishsha asar elef usheva meot vachamishshim. veamar od anshe hatztzava bazzu ish lo achar shekkevar hodia hakkatuv lemala bizzat anshe hatztzava shebbazzu leatzman, gam en ze mekom hodaa zo, ella ba lehodia ki lo chol kele zahav shel midyan hayu ellu, ella ma sheheviu hammemunnim shel hatztzava millevad ma shebbazzu anshe hatztzava kol echad leatzmo. vehakkavvana baze shemmatzu lahem osher gadol.

rashi: Teshivenu achor. leshon hove hu:
Shasu lamo. bazzu nechasenu ish lo:
targum: Achzartana kedal kodam meika umesanana cheveshu lana:

rashi: Ki lo el chafetz resha atta. venae lecha leabbed harisha min haolam:
Lo yegurcha ra. lo yagur etzlecha:
targum: Metul dela elaha rae risha ant la ittotav imach bisha:

ohc: Veet malche vegomer chameshet vegomer. taam shehutzrach hakkatuv lehazekir minyanam, lomar shennehergu yachad ze im ze verau ze et ze bemappaltan. veamro malche midyan paam sheniyya, ulay shennitkavven bechefel haddevarim lomar sheharagum bidia shehem malche midyan velo behessach haddaat:

Hargu vecharev. hutzrach lomar hargu, hagam shemmuvan hu sheharaguhu missemichut zichrono im hanneheragim. yitbaer al pi divrehem zichronam livracha (sifre) sheamru ki bilam halach mimmidyan likrat yisrael leyaatzam leval yillachamu bemidyan, veamar lahem: uma kesheheyitem vechulei, ad kan. haddevarim yaggidu ki bilam neherag kodem harigat Adonai malche midyan, vehu ma shennitchakkem Adonai veyiched lo hariga bifne atzmo, lehaircha shello neherag immahem, shello haya muvan ken im lo haya omer hargu. veamro becharev, lomar shebbittelu keshafav beerech yisrael vaharaguhu begashmi.

rashi: El hannechilot. menachem patar bechullan: nechilot vaalamot, gittit, yedutun – kullam shemot kele zemer hem, uneimat hammizmor hayta lefi shir harauy leoto keli. umidrash aggada yesh mefarshim nechilot leshon nachala; veen ze mashmaut hatteva, vegam inyan hammizmor eno medabber benachala. veyittachen liftor nechilot – geyasot, kemo nachil shel devorim (bava kamma 10:); uchemo "venachale veliyyaal" (Shmuel 2 22:5), vetirgem yonatan: "siat chayyavin". tefilla bishvil geyasot oyvim habbaim al yisrael; veomer hameshorer mizmor hazze bishvil kol yisrael:
targum: Leshabbacha al chingin tushebachta ledavid:

ohc: Vaydabber vegomer lemor hechaltzu vegomer. tzarich ladaat: 1 amro lemor lemi yomru. 2 amro hechaltzu vegomer lamma lo tzivva kasseder sheamar bemilchemet amalek lihoshua (Shemot 17:9) "bechar lanu anashim", kemo chen kan haya lo letzauot lefinchas sheshshalach immahem velo lichlalut haam. gam sheen derech ze nachon, ki mi mefis ladaat mi ze hu sheyyezarez atzmo latzet, vechol echad yomar lo alay hammitzva laasot. 3 amro veyihyu al midyan shehaya lo lomar "veyillachamu bemidyan" kederech amro (sham) "hillachem baamalek". 4 lamma shinna middivre Adonai ki Adonai amar elav "nekom nikmat bene yisrael" vehu amar "nikmat Adonai", vehaya tzarich ledayyek maamar Adonai. Adonai amro elef lammatte lamma lo shalach kol haam laasot nekama baggoyim harshaim, veal mi samach lishloach anashim muatim shenem asar elef leam rav, vetze ulemad ribbuyam mittappam hannisharim shehayu shenayim usheloshim elef.

Achen lefi ma shehikdamnu ki yesh beinyan milchama zo mechush tzodek, velaze ba haelohim benoam devarav lemoshe "nekom" vegomer lehaircha seder hammilchama beseder shebbo yekayyem devar hannekama asher tzivva Adonai. laze nitchakkem velo ratza livchor anashim al yede hazzulat, ki mi yodea haanashim asher lo chashvu machshevot aven velo tau bemichshol umma zo. veyaatz veamar lahem sheyyechaltzu mehaeda, perush hem meatzman kol mi sheyyodea atzmo shehu bar levav uneki chappayim yimmaser lecheshbon haelef lammatte. vehu ma sheramaz betevat lemor maamar hannelam shehu inyan nekiyyutam mechet midyan, lehavechin beatzmo kol echad mehannimsarim im hu naki uvar. veulay ki ramaz gam ken betevat lemor inyan haarayot, keamram zichronam livracha (sanhedrin 56:) "lemor" zo gilluy arayot, sheamar lahem shetztzerichin sheyyihyu hachalutzim nekiyyim mehachet. uchemo sheggamar omer "anashim latztzava", veamru rabbotenu zichronam livracha (tanchuma) kol anashim tzaddikim. vahagam shepperashnu bimkomot acherim sheen ze ella keshettihye tevat anashim yetera, bema shellefanenu yaggid alav reo ma sheddiyyaknu bainyan. velaze en lahem lachush lemichshol kevan shehayyotzim latztzava tzaddikim. veod lahem sheyyikkaru chasidim kevan shebba leyadam avon ze venitztzolu mimmennu, keamram zichronam livracha (zohar chodesh 3 195:) shellaze yikkare chasid. beemtzaut ken tihye hannekama been mechush. velaze lo ratza sheyyirtzu kol yisrael latztzava, ki bederech ze yesh mechush meniat hannekama, veadrabba lehefech kannizkar:

Veyihyu al midyan – yitbaer al pi ma sheamru anshe emet, shebbechinat hakkedushsha hu yesod haaliyya, uvechinat hakkelippa hi sod hayyerida. uchesheadam chote venidbak bo chelek hara, tafil bo tivah visodah lehashepilo. uferat ze perashnuhu befarashat ki tissa et rosh bene yisrael (Shemot 30:12), shehachote yachof keagmon rosho veomed begeder hashshiflut. vehu amro veyihyu al midyan, perush shello yihye bahem mehattuma hassovevet hashevaatam lemidyan, ella yihyu begeder hattov sheomdim lemala.

Veamro "latet nikmat Adonai" – gam ze mehahitchakkemut lehassagat hannekama, shetztzivva otam shettihye kavvanat hannekama lekinat Adonai asher garmu bittul mitzvotav uretzono yitbarach, velo lehitnakkem al hammesubbav mehachet shemmetu kamma miyyisrael, ki lichshettihye hakkavvana al ze en bammaase mitzva lehistayyea beemtzautam lehinnakem meoyev. vahagam she amar elav "nikmat bene yisrael", lo amar elav sheyyomar leyisrael lashon ze, ella sheddevarav hayu im moshe "nekom nikmat bene yisrael", umoshe nitchakkem laasot haddavar bederech ze lekayyem hannekama shel yisrael shennitztavva aleha bemaamar "nekom".

Od yitbaer hakkatuv al ze hadderech, sheen tzorech sheyyillachamu hem, ella yihyu sham alehem, perush bishvilam. vehattaam – latet nikmat Adonai, perush nekama sheyyitnakkem Adonai bemidyan beemtzautam, al derech amro (Shemot 14:14) "Adonai yillachem lachem".

Veamar hakkatuv vayyimmasru mealfe yisrael, perush, kol mi shehaya yodea beatzmo sheomed betzidko masar atzmo laddavar, ad shebbau lichlal haelef. vahagam shehayu beyisrael kahenna vechahenna mehatztzaddikim, nitchakkem Adonai kede shello levayyesh hannisharim shello yihyu nikkarim.
Veim hafer yafer. perush, afilu bindarim sheyyesh bahem hafara, im yafer venasa vegomer:

El ohel moed zikkaron vegomer lifne Adonai. tzarich ladaat lamma katav beseder ze shehifsik ben zichron hammakom uven maamar "lifne Adonai", shehaya lo lomar "el ohel moed lifne Adonai zikkaron livne yisrael"? veyitbaer hakkatuv al pi ma sheamru bemassechet kalla veze leshonam: amar rav achay bar yoshiyya, kol hamefanne atzmo min haavera, afillu hu yisrael rauy hu lehaalot ola kechohen gadol al gabbe hammizbeach vechulei, ad kan. uma shellefanenu kol kele maase sheherimu happekudim hayu mehaanashim sheppinnu atzman mehaavera, vehakkelim bau migguf haddavar, sheamru zichronam livracha (Shir HaShirim 6:6) shekkach haya minhagam beotah milchama: keshehayu mafshitim tachshitehem hayu tachin penehem betit varefesh vehayu porkin nizmehem mehem shello yistakkelu bahem. vehu ma shennitkavven bema shessamach maamar "lifne Adonai" lemaamar "livne yisrael", ki bene yisrael ellu reuyim lihyot lifne Adonai kemaamar rav achay bar yoshiyya, vehaya haddavar lezikkaron.

Veim lo yaavru chalutzim ittechem. perush, hagam sheyyaavru achar kach yeachazu vetochchem. vetaam amro venochazu betosefet vav velo amar "yeachazu", nitkavven lirmoz diyyuk hatzelachatam hannishma mippasuk "im yaavru" al ze hadderech, veim lo yaavru en hatzelachatam baaretz hallezu, umeatzman yeachazu vetochchem letzad hammetzer lahem baaretz, venimtzeu bittelu hammitzva veshellahem lo higgiam.

Vayyomer bene gad vegomer lemor avadecha yaasu vegomer. kashe: 1 amro lemor lemi yomar moshe. 2 ma chiddush bedivrehem avadecha yaasu halo kevar hem kadmu veamru ma shetztzivva otam moshe. 3 achar sheamru bederech kelal "avadecha yaasu kaasher adoni metzavve" lamma hutzrechu lomar od tappenu vegomer yihyu sham vegomer vaavadecha yaavru. od lamma kaflu lomar kaasher adoni dover, vahalo kevar amru "avadecha yaasu kaasher adoni metzavve". 4 lamma shinna, befasuk rishon amar metzavve uvefasuk sheni amar dover?

Achen lefi ma shepperashti bedivre moshe shennitkavven lechaddesh lahem shettihye kavvanat avaratam lammilchama kemishpat ohave shemo, kemo shekkatav rambam beferek 7 mehilchot melachim, gam beinyan perat hakedamat arim lattaf levinyan gidrot tzon, keamram zichronam livracha (Bamidbar Rabba kan) shehem chibbevu hammamon mittaf umoshe hafach lahem, laze heshivu yachad keish echad "vayyomer bene gad" vehiskimu lemaamar moshe bishne happeratim shechiddesh lahem moshe, vehitchilu mehassamuch shehu inyan chibbuv tappam mimmamonam veamru tappenu vegomer vechol behemtenu, hare shehikdimu tappam livhemtam kedivre moshe. veachar kach amru gam ken hodaatam asot bapperat harishon shettihye kavvanatam bammilchama lifne Adonai, vehu amram "vaavadecha yaavru kol chalutz tzava lifne Adonai kaasher adoni dover", velo kemo sheamru battechilla "nechaletz chushim lifne bene yisrael ad havionum" vegomer:

Vehinne letzad ki shene devarim ellu yesh alehem chiyyuv lekayyemam bishvil shekkach hitna alehem moshe, vechol tenay shebbemamon kayyam hagam sheyyihye hammatne ish hedyot, laze nitchakkemu bitchillat divrehem veamru ki gam belo chiyyuv hattenay alehem lekayyem kol divre moshe nevi Adonai dichtiv (Devarim 18:15) "elav tishmaun", vehu ma shennitkavvenu bemaamar rishon sheamru avadecha yaasu kaasher adoni metzavve otanu laasot gam belo taam shehu tenay netinat haaretz, velaze amar tevat lemor, perush, bemaamarcha levad chova alenu laasot mitzvatcha.

Gam yirtze leshon illuy verommut, ki davar ze amaruhu bene gad uvene reuven letzad maalat melech venavi, veachar kach pershu haddevarim veamru avadecha yaasu kaasher adoni dover, perush, gam millevad chiyyuv habba mechamat hammitzva yesh chova alenu laasot, hagam shello haya haddavar mitzva ella dibbur, kaddevarim haovrim ben adam lachavero beinyene tenae mekach umimkar zoche umezakke beinyene haolam. vehakkavvana baze shemmekabbelim gam ken alehem haddavar kaddevarim shemmitchayyev adam lachavero bitnae hammamon shekkayyamin kiri mutzak.

Vehayyotze mippichem taasu. hakkavvana bemaamar ze shello yavinu shehechlit lahem maamar binyan hearim vegomer al kol panim, ella tenay hu haddavar. o nitkavven lehashiv lema sheamru sheim yivnu are mivtzar veyeshvu sham tappam sheyyitakkevu ad sheyyinchalu yisrael nachalatam baaretz. laze amar vehayyotze vegomer, perush, perat ze im lo heyitem omrim oto en tzorech bo lemechush sheyyesh bainyan, vehaya day beakkavatchem sham ad tashlum sheva shene kibbush veen tzorech lehitakkev sham arba esre shana, ulefi sheattem amartem ken – hayyotze mippichem taasu. vetimtza shello hitna alehem moshe ella ad shennichbesha velo ad shennechleka kaamur bemaamar hattenaim, lomar sheen tenay ze meakkev ella lekayyem hayyotze mippihem.

Vayyomru el moshe vegomer vannakrev vegomer. perush maamar vayyomru vegomer velo nifkad vegomer hu lehasir mehem chashash michshol avon, kammuvan mimmin hakkarban asher hikrivu tachshite nashim, umaamar vannakrev vegomer hu taam hakkarban shehu lechapper al hirhur avon, kemaamaram zichronam livracha beshabbat (shabbat sad.) uferashtihu bechibburi (chafetz Adonai):

rashi: Virommuhu bikhal am. tzarich leodoye beappe be asara (berachot ned:):
Uvemoshav zekenim. vetaren minnayyhu tzureva merabbanan (bava batra 15.):
targum: Umerommin yateh bichnishat ama bet yisrael uvesanhedrin dechakkimaya yeshabbechun yateh:

rashi: Boker tishma koli. babboker ani kore lecha alehem, shehu et mishpat barshaim, kemo shenneemar "labbekarim atzmit kol rishe aretz" (tehillim 101:8), "heye zeroam labbekarim" (Yeshayahu 33:2), "ki vabboker babboker yaavor" (Yeshayahu 28:19):
Boker eerach lecha. tefillati al zot, eeroch leshon maaracha hu, kach chibbero menachem:
Vaatzappe. shettaase bahem mishpatim:
targum: Adonai betzafra shema kali betzafra asader kadamach veesteche:

ohc: Venichbesha haaretz. tzarich ladaat lamma lo hispik bemaamar "ad horisho" sheamar besamuch? od tzarich ladaat lamma hutzrach lomar veachar tashuvu, shemmuvan hu meamro "ad horisho" vegomer, hare gevul hahalicha, umuvan meatzmo sheyyashuvu achar kach. achen kavvanat moshe baze hu havetachat hattova hannimshechet mikkiyyum haddevarim, ki beemtzaut maase hakkodem yuvtechu bechamma havetachot: 1 venichbesha haaretz – perush, vadday shettikkavesh haaretz lifne Adonai, 2 veachar tashuvu – perush, hivtiach kol hammedabber alehem shello yippakdu bechol zeman sheyyihyu baaretz bammilchamot haggedolot veyashuvu shelemim levetam. vahagam shemmatzinu (bava batra 121:) sheyyair ben menashshe neherag bemilchemet haay, chatzi hamenashshe lo haya meotam sheddibber moshe immahem az, kammuvan mehakketuvim.

Od hodiam shebbaze yihyu nekiyyim meAdonai umiyyisrael, perush: meAdonai – kesheyyaavru lammilchama al derech shekkatavti shettihye kavvanatam lekaddesh shem shamayim velo lahanaatam bishvil kiyyum tenay haaretz, umiyyisrael – leval yachshedu shettina hayta velibbam mehammeraggelim kemo sheamar lahem moshe "kamtem tachat avotechem tarbut anashim chattaim" shekkavvanatam lashuv meachare Adonai. veamro vehayta haaretz vegomer – hivticham shebbaze titkayyem beyadam haaretz laachuzza velo tihye nigzelet mehem, umimmotza davar atta lamed sheim lo yaasu kidvar moshe yushlelu mikkol havetachot hattovot.

Veamro lifne Adonai efshar shennitkavven lehachezikam bikdushshat haaretz mehatteamim atzman sheamru hem bitchillat divrehem, veze hu shiur devarav: vehayta haaretz hazzot vegomer, hagam shehu chutza laaretz tihye nechshevet lachem laachuzza lifne Adonai, perush, tihye nechshevet achuzza zo shehi lifne Adonai, vezo hi kedushshatah, shelletaam ze hi shennechshevet haaretz kedosha lefi shehi lifne Adonai been retzuat chol mafseket benah uven Adonai shochen habbira.

rashi: Harima feamecha lemashshuot netzach. hagebeah peimot uvehalot shellecha sheyyehu leoyvecha lemashshuot netzach, al kol asher hera haoyev bevet hammikdash. ken chibbero menachem im "vattippaem rucho" (Bereshit 41:8):
Lemashshuot. leshon churban, kemo "shaiyya" (Yeshayahu 24:12), "tishshae shemama" (Yeshayahu 6:11) (sefer acher eno):
targum: Arem istavrach lemishvak umaya lealmin dibbechol cheleh avesh beel devava bekudesha:

ohc: Vayyomru el moshe veel elazar hakkohen veel nesie haeda. tzarich ladaat lamma lo hispik lahem ledabber lemoshe levaddo, veim en tzorech baddavar lamma hutzrach hakkatuv lehazekiram? veulay shehakkavvana hi lomar shehaya haddavar kederech shetztzivva Adonai asot benachalat haaretz, dichtiv befarashat elle mase (Bamidbar 34:17): "elle asher yinchalu lachem et haaretz elazar hakkohen vihoshua bin nun venasi echad nasi echad" vegomer, shetztzarich melech vechohen gadol vehannesiim, vehem haamurim kan. vetaam shehitzrich Adonai shelashtam, lefi shekkol echad yesh lo koach acher, hammelech timtza shekkatav rambam beferek 4 mehilchot melachim veze leshono: kol haaretz shekkovesh hu shello venoten laavadav uleanshe hammilchama kefi ma sheyyire, ad kan. hare shehammelech beyado hakkol. elazar vehannesiim kesheen retzon hammelech latet ella lechol echad harauy lo kefi hachalukka tzerichin kol baale hachalukka lehizdammen lachlok. vehakkohen ladaat asher yaskim el elyon beeze makom yittol peloni chelko. ha lamadta shekkol hashshelosha tzerichin lihyot behasekamat netinat chelek baaretz, kol echad yesh lo koach acher. uma gam sheyyesh baze letzadded sheen din melech shennoten lemi sheyyirtze ella achar chalukkat haaretz vishivat yisrael bearehem, aval lo bitchillat hayyerusha, sheen lammelech mishpat ze, velachen hutzrechu bene gad uvene reuven laamod gam ken lifne elazar vehannesiim. veamro lemor, ulay yirtze sheyyomru leyisrael kullan davar sheyyaskimu alav. o yirtze amira rakka leshon ritztzuy.

Vayhi hammalkoach vegomer vattehi hammechetza vegomer vayhi hammeches vegomer vattehi mechetzat vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma heerich kol kach bifrate hacheshbon bedavar sheyyachol kol habba limnot leda ki kach yaale lemechtza vechen yaale lemeches vegomer, gam beinyan mechetzat haeda lo heerich lomar kol perate hassechumim ella cheshbon haole bemachatzit hammalkoach, vegam alav dan anochi shello haya tzarich leamro. veharamban alav hashshalom katav taam haddavar shebba lehodia shello nechsar echad mizzeman hammispar lizman shechatzuhu, ad kan. veen nire beenay davar ze shemma shello nechsar mehammikne bizman muat sheyyesh bo nes, uma gam sheyyitztarech hakkatuv lichtov kol haddevarim bishvilo.

Vehannachon beenay hu, shehodaat perate hacheshbon bemachatzit chelek hayyotzim batztzava hu legallot shehammeches haya millegav, lo shehaya mone chamesh meot venoten echad laAdonai mippeat hammeches, ella mone arba meot tishim vatesha venoten echad, velaze heela kol perate cheshbon hammeches, umimmennu teda shehayu notnim echad learba meot tishim vatesha.

Vehodaat cheshbon mechetzat haeda – ba hakkatuv lehasir taut acher, vehu sheyyomar haomer leolam meches shennatnu anshe hatztzava haya echad mechamesh meot millevar, veen reaya missechum hammeches sheala hammeches lomar sheim ken lo haya ole meches shel shelosh meot sheloshim veshiva elef vachamesh meot tzon lammispar haamur. yesh lomar shehayu notnim oto hammeches mimmachatzit haeda, shebbaze yaale mispar haamur bammeches chelek hatztzava hagam sheyyihye nittan millevar. asher al ken ba hakkatuv umana mispar chelek haeda umenao shalem lehasir mechush ze, velaze lo perat hakkatuv bemispar chelek haeda ella mispar hammachatzit letzorech ma shekkatavti shehammeches nittan millegav vechol echad shillem chelko mimmachatzito, vehu gam ken ma shetztzivvahu Adonai bemaamar "mimmachatzitam tikkachu" lomar shello yifreu hammeches ella mimmachatzitam, vegam amar echad mechamesh meot, ha lamadta shetztzarich sheyyihye hammeches millegav.

Vayyiggeshu vegomer. taam amro vayyiggeshu, hagam sheshsham hayu omdim lefanav ledabber elav, efshar shennahagu beatzman harechaka keshekkaas alehem moshe veamar lahem "kamtem tachat avotechem tarbut anashim chattaim", laze kesheratzu ledabber amar hakkatuv "vayyiggeshu".

O lefi shemmiddivre moshe shettala lahem hammenia bidvarim shebbeyadam letakkenam, laze haya lahem abbirut lev vechizzeku yadayim rafot lageshet elav beyoter mimmakom shehayu bo kesheddibberu elav devarim harishonim.

Gidrot tzon vegomer. kashe lamma hutzrechu lemaamar ze shel "gidrot tzon" vegomer, shello haya lahem lomar ella teshuva hassoteret hassagotav shel moshe haamura bedivrehem besamuch, shehu "anachnu nechaletz chushim vegomer lo nashuv vegomer ad hitnachel". veyitbaer al pi ma shekkatav rambam beferek 11 mehilchot mechira veze leshono: hammocher bayit lachavero o netano lo bemattana al menat sheyyelech immo lirushalayim beyom peloni vehechezik ze babbayit, kana kesheyyelech immo lirushalayim beoto hayyom. aval im hitna veamar lo "im telech immi lirushalayim beyom peloni etten lecha bayit ze" vechulei, vehalach immo beoto hayyom, af al pi shehechezik babbayit achar shekkiyyem hattenay lo kana, shezze asmachta, ad kan. uveferek 1 mehilchot mechira katav veze leshono: ketzad hachazaka? machar lo bayit, machar lo sade o shennatan vechulei, kevan shennaal o paratz o gadar kol shehu, vehu sheyyoil maasav, hare ze kana, ad kan leshono.

Veal pi haddinim nitchakkemu bene gad uvene reuven ledabber divrehem, kevan shemma shellifnehem hu haddavar bitnay bammetziut atzmo shekkatav rambam beferek 11 mehilchot mechira, shehem mekabbelim haaretz bitnay sheyyaalu immahem leeretz yisrael, velaze hikdimu zechiyyatam baaretz kodem hattenay shehu metziut shekkatav bo rambam, veamru gidrot tzon nivne vegomer, perush nachzik baaretz lizchutenu meachshav, utenay hu haddavar al menat shennaale laaretz im achenu bayyom sheyyaalu. veamru ofen hachazaka gidrot tzon vegomer, nitkavvenu laasot hachazaka bechol hammekomot bema sheyyaasu bo gidrot latztzon vearim lattaf, perush, yivnu bederech sheyyoilu maasehem baaratzot kemishpat hachazaka.

Veim tomar, lamma hutzrechu lomar haddevarim, vehayu yecholin lehachazik meatzman been tzorech hodaa? hinne katav rambam beferek 1 mehilchot mechira veze leshono: bamme devarim amurim? shehechezik bifne hammocher o hannoten, aval shello bifne hammocher vechulei tzarich sheyyomar lo lech chazak ukene, veachar kach im hechezik kana af al pi shehu shello bifne habbealim, ad kan. velaze nitkavvenu kan lomar inyan hachazaka lifnehem kede sheyyaskimu, shezzulat ze en chezkatam chazaka. velaze keshehiskim moshe al haddavar amar lahem benu lachem arim vegomer, vehu ma shekkatav rambam sheamar lo "lech chazak ukene".

Velisvarat ramban vesiato shecholkim im harambam bedin ze, vesovrim shekkol shehattenay kiyyumo taluy beyad hallokeach o hammekabbel mattana en bo din asmachta, mishshum shehammakne gamar vehikna, kefi ze tzarich leyashshev taam maamar binyan haggederot vearim, ki hu leval yitchayyevu laavor hayyarden ad sheyyachinu haggederot veyivnu hearim veaz yechaltzu lalechet immahem, vehu amro "gidrot tzon nivne lemiknenu vearim letappenu" veachar kach "anachnu nechaletz chushim" vegomer.

Veim lo taasun ken hinne chatatem. kashe, lo haya lo lomar ella "veim lo taasun ken lo tihye haaretz hazzot lachem". achen kavvanat hammaamar hu sheim lo yaasu kedivre moshe shetztzivva otam sheyyelchu lekayyem mitzvat milchemet chova laasot nekama beoyve Adonai, hagam sheyyaavru chalutzim hinne chatatem, perush, ma shellefanenu kevar yesh beyedchem chet, vehu ma sheddikdek lomar "chatatem laAdonai" kevar.

Udeu et chattatchem vegomer. perush, modiam shemmi sheyyesh chet beyado yimtzaehu bishat hassakkana veyippara mimmennu, vehu amro asher timtza etchem bifshitut. vetze ulemad mimmaamaram zichronam livracha (tur orach chayyim siman ned) shechozrim meorche hammilchama al chet kal im sach ben yishtabbach leyotzer, uchemo chen yimtzaem avon ze veyechseru kol hahatzlachot harshumim bidvarav, gam az lo yihyu nekiyyim meAdonai umiyyisrael, ki mehammikre hara adrabba yatzdiku ki lo nekiyyim hayu. veayyen ma shepperashti bitshuvat bene gad uvene reuven sheamru "avadecha yaasu kaasher adoni metzavve" (Bamidbar 32:25).

Nekom nikmat vegomer. mashmaut hakkatuv yaggid shehetil Adonai al moshe lehinnakem mimmidyan, verainu sheafillu lammilchama lo yatza immahem. vahagam shepperashti shehannekama hi haamira sheyyomar lahem, im kol ze peshat hakkatuv mashma shehu atzmo yinkom, lo sheyyishlach pinchas bimkomo. od lamma tala asifat moshe benikmat midyan?

Achen kavvanat maamar "nekom" sovelet shene derachim: 1, hu hishtaddelut seder hammaase, perush hitchakkemut seder hammilchama letoelet hannitztzachon, ben bashshiur hatztzarich ben basseder shebbo yassig leabbed kamav vehaarachat hallochamim vechaddome. 2, hammilchama atzmah shehi peullat hannekama. vehevin moshe perush tzodek ki kavvanat "nekom" vegomer sheamar Adonai hi hitchakkemut seder haddavar shebbeemtzauto tihye hannekama. uferush ze hatzedakato hi mimma shello amar lo Adonai beferush "hillachem bemidyan" shehu lashon muchra, gam lefi shehiskil bema shellefanenu shehu tzarich lehitchakkemut beseder haddavar, mittaam ki hinne haam asher yetzav Adonai alehem hannekama hem am asher nichshelu bene yisrael bahem baarayot, mehem bemaase mehem bemachshava. vahagam shennagaf Adonai kamma vechamma, sof kol sof yimmana mehem hannes bahem, veadrabba yekatreg hammekatreg lehappilam bemilchamotam letzad shemetz heavon. veze yidme lemaase haegel shehagam shennagaf Adonai kol ovdav, im kol ze yetzav Adonai leval yikkanes kohen gadol lifnim bevigde zahav, gam tzivva (pirki derabbi eliezer perek 4) shochne shamayim lechassot bechanfehem et raglehem sheddomim leregel egel leval yitorer hammekatreg. umikkol shekken beet hammilchama sheyyitorer hammekatreg al hachet shebba mehem. vetze ulemad (sota 44.) shiur hachet sheyyachzeru alav meorche hammilchama, uchemo chen yittafsu bechol shehu mehirhur hattiuv, veen tzarich lomar sheyyihyu menue hannes. velaze kesheamar Adonai lemoshe "nekom", amar, vadday kavvanat Adonai hu hahitchakkemut beseder hainyan leharim hammechush haamur, vezo hi ikkar haddavar shettaale beyadam hannekama, uchemo chen asa bechachmato eved Adonai kaasher avaer besamuch.

Veamro achar teasef el ammecha – nire ki nitkavven lomar lo shekkodem lachen eno shalem hattikkun leasef el ammav, perush sheyyihye lo monea baddin veyimnaennu miggeshet nafsho limkom moshavah sheyyikkare "ammav" kayyadua, ad sheyyaamidennu bammishpat, ki al hakkol yavi Adonai bammishpat usevivav nisara meod, vehammonea hu lefi shehashshalem hazze nitrappa bemaase zimri velo asa davar, keamram zichronam livracha (Bamidbar Rabba 20,24) sherafu yadav, vehikpid Adonai alav shello nakam ad sheamad pinchas. velaze keshehiggia zeman petirato amar Adonai elav tikkun ledavar ze shennimna mehitnakkem meose resha – yakum veyitnakkem mimmidyan shessibbevuhu, veachar sheyyashlim hattikkun leasef el ammav been satan veen vechulei, veze mechasde el veahavato lididav yanchem bemagele tzedek.

Meet hammidyanim. amro meet velo hispik lomar mehammidyanim, ulay sheramaz lezulatam hannimtza ittam, vehu bilam shennimtza sham az vaharaguhu, dichtiv (Bamidbar 31:8) "veet bilam" vegomer. veulay ki laze miher Adonai haddavar kodem sheyyachzor bilam leartzo, ki lo haya bemidyan ella lakachat secharo, keamram zichronam livracha (sanhedrin kav.), veomed lachzor, vaAdonai paras reshet leraglo vetzado lecherev nokemet.

Vayyomer moshe vegomer unetattem lahem. amar "unetattem lahem" shennire ki hem hannotnim, uvesamuch amar hakkatuv "vayyitten lahem moshe vegomer et mamlechet" vegomer (Bamidbar 32:33), lefi sheen hechlet hannetina ella achar kiyyum hattenay, laze amar unetattem. venishar ladaat lamma amar unetattem shehaya lo lomar "tittenu lahem". veulay sheramaz lahem haddevarim atzman sheamar livne gad uvene reuven, sheim yelchu – yatzlichu kol yisrael, ben hannochalim baaretz ben hannochalim beever hayyarden, vehu amro im yaavru vegomer venichbesha vegomer hatzelachat nochale haaretz, unetattem vegomer hatzelachat nochale ever hayyarden. veremez ze lo haya nishma im haya omer "tittenu lahem".

rashi: Ale asor vaale navel. kinnor shel asara nimin (arachin 13:):
targum: Al pum kinara daasarte nimin veal pum nivla ale rinnat kinaraya:

ohc: Ki lo ninchal vegomer ki vaa vegomer. amro ki lo ninchal, hu netinat taam lema sheamru besamuch "ad hitnachel bene yisrael" vegomer, shehotziu atzman mehannachala. laze amru taam sheanu meyachasim hannachala leyisrael velo lanu, mittaam "ki lo ninchal ittam ki vaa" vegomer, perush, mittaam shebbaa nachalatenu vegomer. o nitkavvenu lomar sheachar shekkibbelu alehem kol haamur, yivvada atta shettaam sheelatam lo mittaam yiratam mimmilchemet haammim hu, kemo shebba hachashad bedivre moshe, ella mittaam sheen lahem nachala baaretz, ki Adonai natan lahem nachalatam kevar meever hayyarden mizracha.

Harogu. hutzrach lomar paam sheniyya "harogu", amar rabbi yishmael (sifre) lehafesik vechulei, sheim lo chen yihye maamar "vechol ishsha" vegomer shakul im nimshach lemala o lematta. vekashe shehaya lo lehakedim tevat "hachayu lachem" befasuk "vechol hattaf" al ze hadderech "hachayu lachem", uvaze en tzorech lichpol maamar "harogu". veulay shechash lomar ken sheaz tihye hakkavvana shehu metzavve otam lehachayotam, velo chen machashevet Adonai ella reshut hu omer sheen mitzva lahamitam, velaze hikdim maamar "vechol hattaf" vegomer lomar shello ba ella lehodia ma yihye dinam, lo letzauot bahem.

Veod nishar lanu leyashshev ma shekkashe od, lamma amar hirgu bitchillat hakkatuv velo hispik baharogu" sheamar levassof? veulay shennitkavven lehasemich maamar "hirgu" lemaamar "veatta", lomar shehatteshuva harmuza bivatta" hi bemaase hariga, vechol od shello hargu lo kiyyemu teshuvat hachet. o efshar shennitkavven lehasemich "hirgu" lattaf vaharogu" laishsha vechulei, lomar sheyyesh mitzva al ellu bifne atzman veal ellu bifne atzman. o nitkavven lehasemich zichron hahariga letevat "veatta", lomar sheyyahargum techef umiyyad.

rashi: Amaray haazina Adonai. kesheyyesh bi koach lishol tzerachay lefanecha, uchesheen bi koach lehitpallel lefanecha vehaddeaga atzura belibbi, bina hagigi. haven hagion libbi. kach meforash bammidrash. kol bina shebbammikra hattaam tachat hannun, chutz mizze vachavero (Iyov 34:16) "veim bina shima zot", sheeno shem davar ella leshon haven, kemo (Mishlei 23:1) "bin tavin et asher lefanecha", lefichach hattaam tachat habbet:
targum: Memri atzit Adonai itben rigugi:

rashi: Moadecha. hu bet hammikdash, asher neemar bo "venoadti lecha sham" (Shemot 25:22):
Samu ototam. kesheggavra yadam lehacharivo, az samu lahem et otot kesamehem shehem otot emet. uma hem hakkesamim? "kilkal bachitztzim shaal batterafim" (Yechezkel 21:26):
targum: Achlin meikach bimtza zimnayich shavon atvathon ataya:

ohc: Vayyomru vegomer yuttan et haaretz vegomer. hutzrach lomar tevat vayyomru hagam shehem odam medabberim velo haya hefsek ledivrehem, lahaircha ki ad atta hayu mesadderim hahatztzaa shebbeemtzautam titkabbel hashsheela kederech shepperashti lemala, umikkan hu matchil maamar hashsheela. veamro yuttan velo amru titten, lefi ma shepperashti ki koach nachalat haaretz hi bemelech vechohen veyisrael, laze amru "yuttan", perush tihye hannetina beofen hammoil, o im yirtze latet moshe levaddo kemishpat hammelech sheyyachol latet kemo shekkatavti, o behasekamat elazar vehannesiim kedin chalukkat haaretz.

Al taavirenu et hayyarden. hakkavvana baze al derech amram zichronam livracha (bava batra kat:) befasuk "vehaavartem et nachalato levitto", shehabbat maaveret hannachala mimmekomah, kemo chen nitkavvenu lomar sheim lo yitten lahem eretz hammikne haruya lahem hinne hu maavir nachalatam mimmekomah.

Od nitkavvenu leharim michshol hachashad bahem shebbocharim beeretz zo letzad hammenucha leval yikkansu leeretz oyvehem, veamru shettaam divrehem eno ella lefi sheenam rotzim linchol beever hayyarden ella kan letzad hahachana sheyyesh lahem, velo kede shello yatrichu bemilchamot yoshve haaretz ki en lahem baze ella haavara.
Od nitkavvenu bemaamar al taavirenu lomar, ki yesh baze davar naot leyisrael, sheyyakelu mealehem ullam velo yitztarchu linchol otam baaretz.

Od efshar shennitkavvenu lishlol haavaratam im yisrael, kederech shehitna alehem moshe levassof, vesamchu al hattaam shennatnu bitchillat divrehem sheamru "asher hikka Adonai", veen tzorech laavor kol chalutz.

rashi: Zacharti lach. im heyitem shavim elay, taavati lerachem alechem, ki zacharti chesed neurayich vahavat kelilat chuppatech, shehichlaltich lechuppa; velashon hachenasa hu. kelulotayich notzish belaaz. uma hu chesed neurayich? lechtech achar sheluchay, moshe veaharon; meeretz noshavet (Shemot 16:35) yetzatem lamidbar, veen tzeda ladderech, ki heemantem bi (mechilta ba pischa yad):
targum: Ezil vetitnabbe kodam ama di virushelem lememar kidnan amar Adonai dacherna lechon tavvat yome kedem rachamat avahatchon dehemnu bememri vaazalu batar teren sheliche batar moshe veaharon bemadbera arbein shenin bela zevadin beara dela mizdara:

ohc: Vayyomer moshe vegomer haachechem yavou vegomer velamma teniun vegomer. hen haadon moshe rabbenu hiskil bedivre bene gad uvene reuven kol ma sheratzu lomar kemo shepperashnu, vetaan keneged ma sheamru shemminnichse gavoah hem shoalim ki haeda lo asu davar, gam ma shennitkavvenu liton keneged heatid sheen torach baddavar ki Adonai hu ose niflaot gedolot levaddo, amar lahem "haachechem yavou lammilchama", perush, emet ki Adonai hu hannilcham lahem, aval al kol panim tzerichin lehizdammen bammilchama, vehu ma sheddiyyek yavou lammilchama velo amar "haachechem yillachamu" lomar sheal habbia bilvad hu tameah, veyesh baze setira al taanat milchama sheavra vegam taanat milchama habbaa baaretz, sheal kol panim kol ish yisrael yesh lahem yegia baddavar, velamma yevakshu hem yegia kappam shel yisrael. vegamar omer veattem teshvu fo, nitchakkem lomar shehagam shehavetachat Adonai hi musseget, sheamirat haggavoah kimsirat hahedyot veen kan yegia, halo taskil biat yisrael lammilchama beerech yeshivatchem po vetiru ki yesh hergesh ligiat biat hammilchama, veim ken lamma tirtzu littol davar shehi yegia shel yisrael kevan sheen attem yegeim immahem beviatchem lemilchemet haaretz?

Gam nitkavven bemaamar teshvu fo betaana hannishmaat, ki eretz sichon veog shehem shoalim netanah Adonai keshehayu mekubbatzim yachad shivte yisrael, shezzechut kullan amad lehanechilam haaretz hallezu, ucheshehem notlim chelkam baaretz nigra meerech zechut harabbim lefi shehem yoshvim po. uvaze satar taanatam shennitkavvenu bemaamar asher hikka Adonai, shezze yaggid al milchamot haaretz sheen torach leyisrael kemo shepperashti lemala, ki lo chen hu sheen haddavar dome.

Ish ki yiddor neder laAdonai vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma kafal lomar yiddor neder o hishshava shevua velo hispik lomar ki yiddor laAdonai o yishshava. od lamma kafal lomar lo yachel vegomer kechol hayyotze mippiv. achen lefi sheyyesh shene mine nedarim ushevuot, echad beinyanim hannogim lannefesh veyitchallek lishne inyanim: echad laasot maase hattov, kegon lilmod ulelammed lehakedish ligmilut chasadim, veechad leharechik hattiuv lehagedir atzmo leval yadur bishchunat ishsha chashuda, leval yelech bechevrat poale aven vechaddome. 2 beinyanim hannogim lagguf bemaase sheen bo lo issur velo mitzva, vegam ze yitchallek lishne devarim: leechol velishtot, ladur bedira zo vechaddome, o shello leechol davar peloni veshello lilbosh malbush ze vechaddome. vitzav Adonai mishpatav kedat ma laasot, veamar "ki yiddor neder", setam neder yaggid al hammaase shennadar lalechet lemakom peloni o laasot eze davar, ulefi sheyyesh neder shehu laAdonai vedino meshunne minnidre chol kaasher yevaer hakkatuv, laze perto veamar "neder laAdonai". nimtzet omer shehizkir hakkatuv shene mine nedarim: nidre chol venidre kodesh.

Veamro o hishshava shevua keneged heder hammaase, kemo sheggamar omer "lesor issar al nafsho", veyesh gam ken baze shene nedarim: nidre chol, kegon leesor devarim sheen mitzva beissuram, o leesor gam ken devarim shehem asurin, kegon boaz shennishba leyitzro.

Venitchakkem Adonai bema sheamar tevat laAdonai ben neder lishvua, lehasemich laAdonai neder ushevua, lomar shehakkefel shebba beneder uvishvua hu perat hannogea laAdonai velo kelalo bichlal nidre chol, lefi sheddino meshunne. vehu ma sheggamar omer lo yachel devaro kechol hayyotze vegomer, perush: keneged nedarim shehem divre chol ushevuot shehem meniat devarim sheen bahem tzarche mitzva, kishvuato shel boaz vechaddome lah, amar "lo yachel" – perush, hu lo yachel aval acherim mattirim lo, uchemo sheppershu razal (nedarim yad.). ucheneged nedarim shehem nidre hekdeshot venidre shamayim ushevuot sheyyesh bahem tzarche mitzva, amar kechol hayyotze mippiv yaase – baze en bahem tenay sheacherim yecholin lehattiro, ella hem devarim sheen lahem hattara.

Od nire lefaresh taam amro laAdonai al pi ma shekkatav rambam beferek 11 mehilchot nedarim veze leshono: katan ben shetem esre shana shennishba o shennadar, bodkim oto im yodea leshem mi nadar vechulei, ad kan. vehu ma shennitkavven Adonai bemaamar neder laAdonai, ki lefi shekkadam veamar ish, ba latet geder sheyyikkare ish ledavar ze, veamar "neder laAdonai" perush kesheyyada leshem mi nadar, vechen bishvua keamro "o hishshava shevua", shehaddin kemo chen bishvua.

rashi: Kodesh yisrael. kitruma:
Reshit tevuato. kereshit katzir lifne haomer, sheasur baachila vehaochlo mitchayyev, ken kol ochlav yeshamu. ken targem yonatan:
targum: Kudeshaya inun vet yisrael kodam Adonai veal bazzehon kedima aramut alla deman daachal mineh chayav lememat ucheshiru chatzad omar aramuta dead la mekarvin mineh kahanaya bene aharon kurebnaya al madbecha man deachil mineh mitchayev af ken kol bazvehon devet yisrael yechovun bishta tete alehon amar Adonai:

rashi: Yasem neharot lemidbar. kelomar: noten yishshuve haummot lechurban:
targum: Shavi neharvata hech madbera umafkanut maya hech tzechuta:

rashi: Ish baar lo yeda. et haamur lematta:
targum: Bar nash shatya la yeda uchesila la yatbayen yat da:

ohc: Veavar lachem kol chalutz. velo hispik ma sheamar "im techaltzu", ba lehatenot davar shello huzekru bedivrehem, vehu sheyyaavru kullam, perush, kol harauy lachalutz tzava. ella sheadayin kashe, shehaya lo lomar befasuk rishon "im techaltzu kullechem" o "im taavru kullechem chalutzim".

Achen kavvanat moshe baze hu havetacha vehodaat diyyuk hannishma al ze hadderech, sheim taasu vegomer vetechaltzu vegomer mavtiach ki lo yippol mehem echad veyihyu shelemim vechen rabbim, vehu amro veavar lachem kol chalutz perush, kullam, velo yippaked mehem ish, umikkelal ze atta shomea sheim lo yaasu haamur hem muchanim lehashechata. ucheferush ze maamar veavar vegomer hu gezera lefasuk shekkadam lo tenay bemaase, shehattenay kevar amar "im taasun haddavar hazze" shepperusho hu hattenay shehitnu hem kemo shekkatavti lemala. veamro lifne Adonai lomar shebbaze lo yihye masach mavdil benam uven Adonai, keamro (Yeshayahu 59:2) "avonotechem hayu mavdilin benechem leven elohechem", shesm harasha vechelotav hem hammavdilim vehem hammechallim.

Od nitkavven lomar lifne Adonai, perush, shehu hammorish oyvav, kemo sheggamar omer "ad horisho", perush, Adonai, leoyvav mippanav. ucheferush ze shiur hakkatuv hu al ze hadderech: im techaltzu vetihye kavvanatchem lifne Adonai vegomer, az enchem tzerichin lemilchama ella haavara levad lifne Adonai vehu yorish oyvav. vehu amro "veavar lachem vegomer lifne Adonai" hayyotze lehinnakem, ad horisho oyvav. ha lamadta ki hu hammorish lifne bene yisrael. vedikdek lomar mippanav, lefi she shochen bair asher bachar lo yerushalayim hachaviva, veeno chafetz lirot oyvav lefanav.

Veyashav tappenu vegomer. hutzrach lomar ze, gam lo amru chen lemala keshehizkiru "vearim letappenu", nitkavvenu lomar sheim yeshvu tappam bearim betzurot az yecholin lehosif od tenay acher, shello yashuvu livnehem ad hitnachel ish nachalato, perush, achar sheyyaavru sheva shanim shel kibbush vesheva shanim shel chilluk, veim lo yihyu beare hammivtzar, perush arim betzurot, ella lishmira kammitztarech, lo yihyu betuchim bahem lehitakkev kol kach arba esre shana ella sheva shanim ad sheyyichbeshu et haaretz. velaze katav maamar "veyashav tappenu beare hammivtzar" beemtza shene hammaamarim shekkullam inyan echad, shehem maamar "vaanachnu nechaletz chushim vegomer ad havionum el mekomam" umaamar "lo nashuv el battenu ad hitnachel" vegomer, umin harauy haya lo lehasemich shene hammaamarim, shehashsheni gezera shel harishon, velo lehafesik beshello kainyan, uledarkenu yityashshev al nachon.

Gam yityashshev lamma amru shene gevulim negdiyyim: 1 "ad asher im havionum" vegomer, vev "ad hitnachel", vehagam shehaechad amru leinyan nechaletz chushim vehashsheni leinyan hashavatam leartzam, im kol ze mippasuk rishon mashma shello chiyyevu atzman ella ad haviam limkoman velo ad hitnachel, velidvarenu ala al nachon.

Veamar lahem moshe "benu lachem arim letappechem", dikdek lomar lachem, perush, lema shebbirtzonchem shehu livnot are mivtzar, vechen haya, dichtiv: "vayyivnu et divon veet atarot" vegomer (Bamidbar 32:34-38), sheellu hem are hammivtzar shehem haayarot haggedolot shehizkiru bishelatam, vetimtza shello chazru levattehem ad achar arba esre shana shel kibbush vechilluk.

Umikne rav vegomer. taam hodaa zo, lehatzedik hakkatuv taam hannimtza befihem lishelat eretz sichon veog ki emet hu. vetaam shehaya lahem yoter mikkol hashshevatim leheyot shehayu gibbore koach bazzu anshe hatztzava chelek merubbe mikkol hashshevatim.

rashi: Limlecha. lihyot keeretz melecha measot peri:
targum: Ara deyisrael deavda peri tzeda hech sedom deithappechat min bishut yatvin bah:

rashi: Hollim. mishtattim, uvilshon mishna meurbavin:
targum: La yitattedun metalavin kovel aynach seneta kol ovde shekar:

ohc: Vayyaanu vene gad vegomer. hutzrechu lehachezir haddevarim, gam amar hakkatuv vayyaanu velo amar "vayyomru", lefi sheamar moshe "unetattem lahem" chashu sheaz tatchil hannetina, laze anu veamru ki avaratam chalutzim hu davar shechayyavin laasoto bidvar melech shilton umilchemet chova hi lahem, vehu amro et asher dibber Adonai laavadecha ken naase nachnu nechaletz chushim lifne Adonai lehillachem beoyvav, aval hannetina hi meachshav, vehu amro veittanu achuzzat nachalatenu, vehem lo hevinu kavvanat divre moshe kemo shepperashnuhu, velaze techef natan lahem uvaze gilla dato ki kavvanato bemaamar "unetattem lahem" hi beyadam kemo shepperashti.
O efshar sheggam moshe dato haya shello yatchil zechutam bah ella achar hattenay, uchesheraa chozek retzonam bammaase hattov hiskim unetanah lahem techef umiyyad.
Chassalat parashat mattot

Vayyomer alehem moshe im taasun vegomer im techaltzu vegomer. kashe, lamma kafal lomar im taasun vegomer im techaltzu vegomer velo hispik beachat mehenna. velichshennedayyek lo haya tzarich lahashivam, ella yaskim ledivrehem bema sheyyikra lihoshua uleelazar vitzav otam kaamur besamuch. od, lamma dikdek lomar "hazze". od, ma kavvanato beamro besamuch "lifne Adonai"?

Achen kavvanat maamar moshe hi, lefi sheraa sheddaat bene gad uvene reuven sherotzim laavor im yisrael eno ella kede sheyyitratztzu veyachlitu lahem netinat haaratzot velo letachlit acher, vedavar ze en nachon laasot ken leinyan hatzelachat hammilchama, ki tzerichin bene hammilchama shettihye milchamtam lehinnakem meoyve Adonai lehacherit lahem kol neshama, vetikkare milchemet chovat mitzvat Adonai, veze lecha leshon rambam beferek 7 mehilchot melachim: kol hannilcham bechol libbo vechulei vetihye kavvanato lekaddesh Adonai bilvad, muvtach lo shello yimtza lo shum nezek velo taggiehu raa vechulei veyizke lechayye olam habba, ad kan.

Al ken haanashim hahemma, kevan sheen holchim ella lehitkayyem beyadam haaretz, yesh mechush bachalitzatam shello toil, veefshar sheyyihyu nizzokim mehem. asher al ken nitchakkem moshe veamar lahem im taasun vegomer im techaltzu vegomer, perush, keneged ma sheamru hem "vaanachnu nechaletz chushim" vegomer, amar "im taasun et haddavar hazze", vetevat "ze" chozeret lammaamar hanneemar besamuch. ucheneged ma shekkavvanatan bahalicha lekiyyum hattenay amar "im techaltzu lifne Adonai lammilchama". dikdek lomar lifne Adonai kemaamar rambam shekkatav shettihye kavvanato lekaddesh Adonai, uchemo sheggamar omer ad horisho et oyvav, perush, oyvav shel hakkadosh baruch hu. veen lefaresh oyvav shel yisrael, shehare lo huzkar bedivre moshe mittechillat devarav ad atta zichron yisrael lomar shealav chozer maamar oyvav, ella vadday ki laAdonai chozrim haddevarim, shettihye kavvanatam lehinnakem meoyve Adonai lekaddesh shemo yitbarach. ucheferush ze hirvachnu gezerat divre moshe shello noda mekomah, shekkol hammaamarim hittil lahem vav bitchillatam, velidvarenu haggezera hi "lifne Adonai".

Od nitkavven beamro im techaltzu lifne Adonai lahashivam lehammuvan bedivrehem sheamru "nechaletz vegomer lifne bene yisrael", shezze yaggid sheyyisrael tzerichin ezer tivi. laze amar "im techaltzu lifne Adonai", "techaltzu" perush, leharebot zechutechem lifne Adonai, sheen doma zechut mea lizchut mea veechad:

Veim hafer yafer vegomer. taam shekkafal lomar hafer yafer, gam ribbuy kol motza, yitbaer al pi ma sheamru bindarim perek 11 (nedarim 82:) veze leshonam: amar rav yehuda vechulei nadra mishte kikkarot, beachat mitanna uveachat en mitanna, mittoch shehu mefer lammitanna mefer gam lesheenah mitanna, ad kan, vehu ma shennitkavven hakkatuv bechefel veim hafer yafer, perush, im hefer bachelek sheyyesh lo hafara, "yafer" lerabbot gam chelek sheen lo bo din hafara. veamar kol motza sefateha vegomer, perush, taam shehu mefer gam chelek sheen bo din hafara lefi shehu kalul im davar sheyyesh bo hafara, ucheshehu mefer mefer kullam yachad. ulesivrat rav ase shechalak sham bindarim veze leshono: rav ase amar mefer lammitanna veeno mefer lesheeno mitanna, ad kan, yitbaer al ze hadderech: "im hafer", perush davar sheyyesh bo din hafara, "yafer" perush toil hafarato, aval lo chelek sheen bo din hafara. veamro kol vegomer lindareha, perush: afillu hem kelulim yachad shene devarim, echad mitanna bo veechad en mitanna bo.

Od yitbaer al pi ma sheamru sham bammishna (nedarim paz.) veze leshonam: yodea ani sheyyesh meferin, aval eni yodea shezze neder – rabbi meir omer: lo yafer, vachachamim omrim: yafer, ad kan. vehu ma shennitkavven hakkatuv bemaamar hafer yafer, perush, afillu en lo shegaga ella bahafara, toil lo lehafer achar zeman kesheyyada sheyyesh meferin, zo kedivre chachamim. ulerabbi meir yitbaer hakkefel lomar sheyyesh metziut shehagam shello hefer bizmanno yafer shello bizmanno, uchegon shello yada sheyyesh meferin. veamro lindareha lisvarat rabbi meir yityashshev al ze hadderech: ematay amarti lecha sheyyachol lehafer achar kach – keshello hayta lo hashshegaga bindarim, vehu amro lindareha, perush, kesheyyakkir nedareha. velisvarat chachamim yitbaer amro "lindareha" – hakkarat heyotah nedareha, ha lamadta shebbah shagag veaf al pi chen ribba bo hafara lomar sheyyachol lehafer lichsheyyeda shehem nedarim.
Hachayu lachem. perush, yegayyeyru otam, shebbaze yikkaru chayyim, kede sheyyihyu reuyot lahem lehinnase lechafetz bahem:

rashi: Yasem midbar laagam mayim. noten yishshuv charev levinyan umachaziro lekadmuto:
targum: Kad tavu leorayta shavi madbera hech arita demaya vaara tzichaya lemafkanut maya:

rashi: Bifroach reshaim kemo esev. enam yodim shehaferachatam enah ella lehashemidam ade ad, shemmeshallem lesonav al penehem lehaavidam (Devarim 7:10):
targum: Kad mitlavlevin rashiaya hech isba venatztzin kol avde shekar vaatid dishetzinun elaha ad alma:

ohc: Vayyishlach vegomer otam veet pinchas vegomer. amro vayyishlach, nitkavven laasotan sheluche mitzva linkom nikmat Adonai, usheluche mitzva enan nizzokin. vechafal lomar otam paam sheniyya lirmoz sheshshakul pinchas keneged kullan.

Vetaam shebbachar befinchas velo yehoshua vechaddome, gam ze mehitchakkemut hannekama, ki ze hu asher kinne veasa bahem shefatim muflaim, vesamuch hu bechoach mufla lehashemid kol haumma hattemea. gam efshar shechash moshe lekitrug haanashim lamma lo michu bazzonim, hagam shehem nekiyyim, laze nitchakkem veshalach hammekanne kinat Adonai bimsirat nafsho. veulay ki hu ma sheddikdek bemaamar otam veet pinchas lomar yashlim ze ma shechaser laze. veulay ki davar ze haya belev taalumot chachma shennikmat midyan tzericha lihyot al yede pinchas, vehen haadon chashav letova shello yachlim moshe lomar lo beferush shelach et pinchas, shezze yaggid shennifsal chas veshalom hu mehammaase, laze nitchakkem vetala haddavar beyad moshe veamar lo "nekom" vegomer, umoshe meatzmo yada hannachon asot vayyishlach pinchas, uvaze naaset machshevet Adonai letova velo nichlam moshe yedid Adonai.

rashi: Veatta marom. bechol mishpatecha yadcha al haelyona, shehakkol matzdikim alehem et dincha:
targum: Veat rema veilaa vealma haden Adonai veat rema veilaa lealma deate:

ohc: Velamma teniun vegomer. perush, millevad hatteanot, od kovel ani alechem "lamma teniun et lev" vegomer. perush, lu yehi sheen kavvanatchem ella latteamim haamurim bedivrechem, im kol ze yesh makom larotze lachshov shettaanotechem hu leyirat am haaretz. vahagam sheattem shollim haddevarim, sheadrabba attem choshvim haaretz keillu kevusha lifne yisrael, efshar shezze etza vetachbula lechassot taam hannikkar shehu leyirat yoshve haaretz. vehen henna divre hammeraggelim sheamru (Bamidbar 13:31) shechazak hu mimmennu. vehu amro "ko asu avotechem" vegomer. od nitkavven lomar lahem shehaya lahem lachush lachashad ze achar shekkevar kadam maase haavot vehaya ma shehaya, sheppachadu am bene yisrael mealot el haaretz. velaze yesh makom lachshov haddavar atzmo kesheyyiru shechelek mehashshevatim mevakkeshim lashevet chutz laaretz.

Asher natan lahem Adonai. nitkavven gam baze keneged ma shennitkavvenu bemaamar "asher hikka Adonai" vegomer, lomar sheddin haaretz yesh lah. amar lahem sheal kol panim yesh hefresh ben haaretz asher hem baim shamma mearetz asher hem rotzim, ki haaretz natan lahem Adonai ma sheen ken eretz sichon veog enah bichlal eretz shennatan Adonai leavraham, vechidtanya (sifre Devarim 299) veze leshonam: "latet lecha" – perat leever hayyarden shennatalta meatzmecha. vahagam shessevara zo sevarat rabbi shimon, aval tanna kamma doresh derasha acheret, midderabbi shimon nishma letanna kamma, ki min hassetam enam cholkim beikkar haddavar im eretz sichon veog hi bichlal ma shennatan Adonai leavraham im lav:

Gam matzinu sheamru razal (Bamidbar Rabba 87) beeser kedushshot, sheen ever hayyarden rauy levet hammikdash velishkon hashshechina, vechen amar hakkatuv (Yehoshua 22:19) "im temea eretz achuzzatchem", ha lamadta sheyyesh hefresh ben eretz sichon veog leeretz yisrael. veefshar ki mittaam ze lo haya bedaat moshe lechallekah lashshevatim, vehaya chafetz sheyyihyu kol yisrael baaretz asher natan Adonai lahem leheyotah yoter kedosha. veayyen befarashat devarim (3:13) befasuk "hahu yikkare eretz refaim":

rashi: Yivvada kemevi lemala bisvach etz kardummot. yodea haoyev, keshehaya makke beshaare pitche hammikdash, shehu kemevi makkotav lemala barakia. uminnayin haya yodea? shehare haya roe shehaya haetz mesabbech veochez et hakkardummot uvolan, kemo sheamru rabbotenu (sanhedrin tzav:): kullehu belatinhu chad tara dirushalayim:
Bisvoch etz kardummot. leshon "neechaz bassevach" (Bereshit 22:13), haetz sovech otam vehem nisbachin bo:
targum: Yatzlef bekurensa hech gevar dimrim yedi bisvich kisaya lemikta bechulevaya:

ohc: Atarot vegomer haaretz vegomer. tzarich ladaat: 1, lamma hutzrechu lefaret kol haayarot velo hispik bammaamar hakkelali sheamru "haaretz asher hikka Adonai" vegomer, sheshsham kelulim kol haaratzot hahem, o haya lahem lomar kederech shehizkiram hakkatuv besamuch bishne kelalim, dichtiv "et eretz yazer veet eretz gilad" (Bamidbar 32:1). 2, amro haaretz asher vegomer, vechi hayu lifnehem aratzot acherim sheshshemam kemo chen shehutzrechu lesammen ellu, veim lomar she hikka otam mi lo yada baze?

Achen hakkavvana hi al ze hadderech, ki haanashim haelle hiskilu ledabber beseder shello yihye makom lehakeshot lishelatam ma sheyyesh lehakeshot bainyan. 1 kevan shehaaretz hallezu hi shel kelalut yisrael, ma kocham lishol davar shel acherim. 2 ech yaale al datam sheyyeshvu betach beeretz asher kevar nichbesha ushear hashshevatim yikkansu besakkanat hammilchamot haatzumot hammuchanot lahem, vechol echad miyyisrael yomar: kedivrechem adabber gam ani, velo achnis atzmi besakkanat haammim. vechol ze lamma shennogea lishlilat haratzon mimmoshe veyisrael, levad ma sheyyesh lehitraem alehem shebbocharim lashevet chutz laaretz hakkedosha vehannivcheret laAdonai.

Asher al ken nitchakkemu bene gad uvene reuven bemaamar rishon, venatnu teshuva lishlosha devarim hannizkarim hammereim sheelatam, bema sheamru atarot vegomer haaretz asher hikka Adonai vegomer, keneged taana rishona shehaaretz hi shel kelalut yisrael, yesh bemaamar ze teshuva laze, shello lakchu haaretz bederech teva lomar halo lanu hi, ella Adonai hu shehikka yoshveha lifnehem, veen ze ella nichse shamayim uminnichse gavoah anu baim lishol.

Gam taana sheniyya sheachehem yikkansu besakkanat milchamot vechulei, setaruha bemaamar ze asher hikka Adonai, perush, bishlama im yerushshat haaretz hayta bederech teva hayta taana zo taana, aval kevan she hu hammakke et yoshve haaretz lifnehem, ma makom lachashash sakkanat milchamot? veze lecha haot – haaretz asher hikka Adonai lifnehem, veze siman lechol haaretz, dichtiv befarashat devarim (Devarim 3:21): "veet yehoshua tzivveti baet hahi lemor enecha haroot et kol asher asa Adonai elohechem lishne malche haemori ken yaase Adonai lechol hammamlachot asher atta over shamma". meatta en makom letaanat pachad hammilchama. venitkavvenu gam ken baze lehasir mechush hannofel bishelatam, sheyyomru shello asu chen ella lefachad milchemet haaretz.

Gam taanat meisat eretz hakkedosha natnu teshuva bemaamar asher hikka Adonai, perush, al derech ma shekkatav rambam beferek 1 mehilchot terumot veze leshono: eretz yisrael haamura bechol makom hu eretz shekkavsha melech yisrael o navi middaat rov yisrael, aval yachid miyyisrael o shevet shehalchu vechavshu leatzman makom afillu min haaretz shennittena leavraham enah nikret eretz yisrael, ad kan. vechatav od sham bedin aratzot shekkavash david veze leshono: umippene ma yardu mimmaalat eretz yisrael? mippene shekkavash otam kodem sheyyichbosh kol eretz yisrael shennishar bah mishshiva amamin, ad kan. veikkar din ze huva besifre (sof parashat ekev) shellamdu din shear aratzot meeretz yisrael mippasuk (Devarim 11:24) "kol makom asher tidroch kaf raglechem bo lachem yihye", lelammed al mekomot shekkibbeshu chutz meeretz yisrael shehu min hammidbar vehallevanon vegomer ad hayyam haacharon vegomer. velamdu shetztzarich lehakedim eretz yisrael middichtiv kodem maamar "kol makom" – "virishtem goyim gedolim" vegomer, shello tihye eretz yisrael mittammea begillulim veattem mechabbeshim chutza laaretz vechulei, ad kan. haddevarim yaggidu shezzulat taam hakkedima, kol shekkevashuha rov yisrael din eretz yisrael yesh lah lechol davar. vehu maamar bene gad uvene reuven haaretz asher hikka Adonai lifne adat yisrael, perush, eretz zo kedushshat haaretz yesh lah, letaam shekkevashuha lifne adat yisrael, vechibbush rabbim dinah keeretz yisrael lechol devareha.

Uletaanat ma sheddiyyeku besifre lomar shekkibbush chutz laaretz kodem kibbush haaretz en lo din eretz yisrael, veim ken eretz sichon veog kodem kevishat haaretz hayta, laze shallu taana zo bemaamar asher hikka Adonai, perush, meshunne kibbush ze lefi shehaya bemaamar Adonai, ki hu amar el moshe al eretz sichon: "veet artzo hachel rash" kaamur befarashat devarim (Devarim 2:31), vegam al eretz og (Devarim 3:2) amar Adonai sham: "beyadcha natatti oto veet artzo veet kol ammo veasita lo" vegomer. meatta Adonai hiskim al hakkedima. veyesh gam ken taam baddavar shello hayu lifnehem shete kevishot, echad shel haaretz veechad shel chutz laaretz, vehikdimu shel chutz laaretz kederech sheasa david shellakach aram tzova kodem shehorish hayyevusi kaamur sham, lomar lamma hinnachtem millichbosh eretz yisrael kodem. veadrabba, kevishat eretz sichon veog hayta tzorech kibbush haaretz kede sheyyaavru derech sham lechavshah, uchevar shalchu lo divre shalom latet lahem maavar derech artzo velo ava. meatta en taromet neged sheelatam meAdonai umiyyisrael.

Uvaze yesh taam nachon lamma hutzrechu lehazekir perate shemot haaretz, ki lema shennitkavvenu bemaamar "asher hikka Adonai" lomar shello bau lishol ella minnichse gavoah, amru ki kol perate hammedinot kullam lo kevashum derech teva ella Adonai hikka otam lifnehem, ben lema shebbau lehachezikam bechezkat kedushshat haaretz dikdeku lehazekir kol hashshemot lomar shekkol achat mehem yeshnah bikdushshat haaretz, umedina acheret zulat ellu enah bichlal, vehayyotze mizze kol ir shebbeever hayyarden zulat ellu en lahem din eretz yisrael lefi sheenah kibbush rabbim.

Veamro eretz mikne hi velaavadecha mikne, nitkavvenu lehasir taana acheret vehi, achar shennaskim lechol hatteanot sheamru, adayin kol shevet veshevet miyyisrael yavo veyomar hatteanot atzman littol et haaretz, ki hatteanot atzman tzodkot lechol shevet miyyisrael. laze amru, en shevet acher tzarich lah kemo shetztzerichin hem lah, lefi shehi eretz mikne velahem yesh mikne rav.

El rashe hammattot vegomer. tzarich ladaat ma nishtannet mitzva zo shepperat bah hakkatuv rashe hammattot, verabbotenu zichronam livracha besifre amru: lefi shebbemaamar hachatzotzrot hikdim keriat haeda lannesiim, chash lomar shehaeda kodemet lannesiim, talmud lomar "el rashe" vegomer shehem hakkodmim. uvemakom acher (nedarim 78:, bava batra 120:) amru shebba lomar hetter nedarim beyachid mumche, vechol ze derech derash veasmachtot. od tzarich ladaat lamma hutzrach lomar hammattot livne, shello haya lo lomar ella "el rashe mattot bene yisrael". vehaya nire lomar shennitkavven ledabber beseder ze, shello tomar shello baa hammitzva ella lerashe hammattot yisrael levad, laze amar "el rashe hammattot livne yisrael", ucheillu amar laze velaze. vahagam shello amar "velivne", harebe mikraot medabberim beseder ze, kederech amro (Shemot 1:2) "reuven shimon" vegomer ucheillu amar "veshimon".

Ella sheraiti barayta (bava batra 120.) veze leshonah: tanya, yachol shello amar moshe parasha zo ella lannesiim bilvad? neemar kan "ze haddavar" veneemar bishchute chutz (Vayikra 17) "ze haddavar", ma lehallan vechulei af zo neemra lechullan. im ken en mashmaut amro "livne yisrael" velivne yisrael", shehare hutzrechu babbarayta lehochiach miggezera shava, uchevar amru rabbotenu zichronam livracha (keritut 5.) veze leshonam: leolam al tehi gezera shava kalla beenecha vechulei.

Od tzarich ladaat kavvanat amro lemor, ki lemi yomru bene yisrael? veim hakkavvana hi sherashe hammattot yomru livne yisrael, haya lo lomar "lemor livne yisrael". od amro ze haddavar, ma ba lemaet betevat "ze"?

Achen yitbaer hakkatuv behakedim maamaram zichronam livracha sheamru (chagiga 10.) veze leshonam: hetter nedarim porchim baavir, ad kan. veyesh lehair lamma asa Adonai mimmitzva zo seder ze, ma shello asa ken bechol hattora, shekkol davar vedavar katuv yosher vezo porachat baavir?

Achen hattaam hu ki lo ratza Adonai sheyyihye katuv leen kol adam shehanneder vehashshevua yeshnam behetter, shebbaze yezalzelu bindarim uvishvuot. velaze nitchakkem Adonai vehelim haddavar umasar hahetter ligdole yisrael, shehem yedu veyavchinu chilluke hammishpatim shebbahetter, aval bifne kol hehamon yihyu neule delet lekayyem kol neder vechol shevua, keamro "lo yachel" vegomer "kechol hayyotze mippiv" vegomer. veze hu shiur hakkatuv vaydabber moshe el rashe hammattot shehem gedole yisrael hammitzva bishlemut, aval livne yisrael lemor ze haddavar perush ki livne yisrael bichlalut lo yomar lahem mehaddibbur hanneemar lerashe hammattot ella ze haddavar, velo happoreach baavir shenneemar beal pe lerashe hammattot (chagiga 10.), uvaze nityashshevu kol haddikdukim.

O yirtze al ze hadderech: el rashe hammattot baa hammitzva, velivne yisrael lemor – perush, ki hannoder vehannishba mibbene yisrael yavo veyomar lerashe hammattot, vehem yaggidu lamo et sheyyeshno beval yachel veet sheyyeshno behattara kefi hahalachot shebbau bemishpat ze.

Veim tomar, lechol hadderachim hare huzkeru gam bene yisrael bemitzva zo, velamma hutzrechu rabbotenu zichronam livracha lilmod haddavar kannizkar? yesh lomar shello hutzrechu ladun bigzera shava, ella lomar shemmoshe amar haddevarim mippiv leyisrael, aval lehodaat hammitzva leyisrael lo hutzrechu ligzera shava. veze hu ma sheddikdeku lomar "yachol shello amar moshe parasha zo ella lerashe hammattot", velo amru "yachol shello neemra parasha zo ella lerashe hammattot", sheaz tihye hakkavvana shello neemra kol ikkar.

Od yesh lomar shezzulat gezera shava shehodia shemmitzva zo noheget beyisrael, hayiti yachol lefaresh amro "livne yisrael" keillu amar "shel bene yisrael", veyihye haddavar shakul. veachar shebbaa gezera shava shehitzdika hammitzva gam beyisrael, anu meyashshevim hakkatuv kadderech haamur. veen lehakeshot lefi ma shepperashnu "ze haddavar" shebba lemaet shello yomar lakkol shehannedarim nittarim bappe, vahare tzericha "ze haddavar" ligzera shava, ki haggezera shava gamar lah mittevat "haddavar", uferushenu hu mittevat "ze" levad, hagam shehaya omer "ze asher tzivva Adonai"
