Uvederech remez yitbaer amro livne yisrael lemor ze haddavar, al pi ma sheamru razal (Bamidbar Rabba 22:1) veze leshonam: leolam yehe adam zahir bindarim, elef ayayrot hayu lo leyannay vechulei, hare shehagam shehayu mekayyemin shevuatan neenshu. veamar hakkatuv kan ki yesh nedarim ushevuot shetztzivva Adonai otam, vehu amro livne yisrael lemor – en "lemor" ella gilluy arayot (sanhedrin 56:), perush lachashash haarayot – "ze haddavar asher tzivva Adonai ish ki yiddor neder" vegomer. vedikdek lomar ish lirmoz letigboret niggud hattaava, keamram zichrono livracha (Rut Rabba 86) befasuk "chay Adonai shichvi" vegomer shennishba leyitzro, vechen amru (chagiga 10.) befasuk "nishbati vaakayyema lishmor" vegomer ki mitzva lishshava leyitzro.

targum: Bar arbein shenin ana kad shelach moshe avda dayya yati merkam gea laalala yat ara vaatevit yateh fitgama kema dahava im libbi:
Bememra dayya anan meshabbechin kol yoma ushemach node lealme almin:
Arum peraktena mimaikana umesanana ayteta alavehon bahata:
Yehodun kodam Adonai metul chasdeh umishtaan perishvateh livne nasha:
Beadva itpalgat lehon achasantehon kema defaked Adonai bida demoshe letishat shivtin ufalgut shivta:
Tzet lekal bauti malki velahi arum kodamach atzali:
Are yehav moshe achasanat teren shivtin ufalgut shivta meivra leyardena ulelevae la yehav achasana benehon:
Umecheshbon ad ramat mitzpaya uvetonim umimachanayim ad techum lidvir:
Ukerivu vene yehuda levat yehoshua begilgala vaamar leh kalev bar yefune kenizaa at yedata yat pitgama demalel Adonai im moshe neviya dayya al esak dili veal esak dilach birkam gea:
Vahava techum bene reuven yardena utechumeh da achasanat bene reuven lezarayathon kirvaya ufatzchehen:
Adliku benura vet makdesha leara appisu mashkan deitkere veh shemach:
Veyahatza ukedemot umefaat:
Vihav moshe leshivta degad livne gad lezarayathon:
Kama ravrevin ovadach Adonai lachada amikin machshevatayich:
Veyat bilam bar beor kisma ketalu bene yisrael becharba al ketilehon:
Vahava lehon techuma yazer vechol kirve gilad ufalgut ara bene amon ad aroer di al appe rabba:
Vahava pitgam nevua min kodam Adonai imi lememar:
Vechol kirve meshra vechol malkevat sichon malka deemoraa dimlach becheshbon dimcha moshe yateh veyat ravreve midyan yat evi veyat rekem veyat tzur veyat chur veyat reva ravreve sichon yatve ara:
Uvet peor umashpach meramata uvet yeshimot:
Da achasanat bene gad lezarayathon kirvaya ufatzchehen:
Arum achditani Adonai beovadach beovade aydach avua:
Vihav moshe leshivta divne reuven lezarayathon:
Vekiryatayim vesivma vetzeret hashachar betura demeshra:
Are havo vene yosef teren shivtin menashe veefrayim vela yehavu chulek lelevae beara elahen kirvin lemittav urevachehon livirehon ulegetehon:
Veilen  deachasinu bene yisrael beara dichnaan deachasinu yathon elazar kahana vihoshua bar nun vereshe avahat shivtaya livne yisrael:
Vihav moshe lefalgut shivtaya dimnashe vahava lepalgut shivtaya divne menashe lezarayathon:
Uvemeshra bet haram uvet nimra vesukkot vetzifuna shear malchut sichon malka decheshbon yardena utechumeh ad seyafe yam ginosar avra deyardena madincha:
Vahava lehon techuma mearoer di al kef nachala dearnon vekarta di vego nachala vechol meshra ad medva:
Kema defaked Adonai yat moshe ken avadu bene yisrael ufaligu yat ara:
Cheshbon vechol kirvaha di vemeshra divon uvamot baal uvet baal meon:

bart: Elo veel haam. taama derabbi eliezer, mishshum deelo veel haam veemure chattat vehotzaat kaf umachta, kol hane dichtive beresha betorat kohanim befarashat hayyom, aved lehu beresha, vahadar aved musafin, par haola veshiva kevasim vesair hannaase bachutz, kullan im tamid shel ben haarbayim dichtiv levassof bechummash happekudim:
Verabbi akiva omer. par haola veshiva kevasim shel musafin:

Im tamid shel shachar hayu kerevin. dichtiv (Bamidbar 28) millevad olat habboker asher leolat hattamid vegomer, alma musafin im olat habboker naasim besamuch lah, veachar kach avodat hayyom, veachar kach sair hannaase bachutz, veaf al pi shehu min hammusafin eno yachol lehakedim laavodat hayyom, lefi shenneemar bo (sham 29) millevad chattat hakkippurim, lamadnu shessair happenimi shehu meavodat hayyom kodmo, veachar kach elo veel haam, veachar kach emure chattat, kol ellu bitvila shelishit. veachar kach hotzaat kaf umachta, veachar kach tamid shel ben haarbayim. vahalacha kerabbi akiva:
Im haya vechezkat hammishtammer. kol zeman shello hodio shehu maflig have vechezkat hammishtammer, vaafillu hiflig mil, dehannachri mirtat veomer hasheta ate yisrael vechaze li:
Im hodio shehu maflig. umitrachek mimmennu vechaviyyot setumot hem:
Kede sheyyishtom. im shaha chede sheyyikkov hannachri nekev bimgufat hechavit veyachazor veyistom hannekev vetivash hassetima, asur:
Yishtom. yiftach. kemo (Bamidbar 24) shetum haayin, sheeno fetucha:
Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer. eno asur ella im shaha chede sheyyiftach et kol megufat hechavit:
Veyaguf. veyaase megufa acheret:

Vetiggov. vetinnagev vetivash. aval linkivat chor bimgufa shel chavit lo chashshu, mishshum deminkera milleta. vedavka vimgufa shel sid hu diflige rabbanan aleh derabban shimon ben gamliel vechayshi liftichat nekev, mishshum delo minkar, shehassid lavan veeno nikkar ben chadash leyashan. aval bimgufat tit, modu rabbanan lerabban shimon ben gamliel delo mittesar hayyayin ad sheyyishhe chede sheyyiftach hammegufa chullah veyagof vetiggov. vahalacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel:

Moshe kibbel tora missinay. omer ani, lefi shemmassechet zo enah meyussedet al perush mitzva mimmitzvot hattora kishar massechtot shebbammishna, ella kullah musarim umiddot, vechachme ummot haolam gam ken chibberu sefarim kemo shebbadu millibbam bedarche hammusar ketzad yitnaheg haadam im chavero, lefichach hitchil hattanna bemassechet zo moshe kibbel tora missinay, lomar lecha shehammiddot vehammusarim shebbezo hammassechta lo badu otam chachme hammishna millibbam, ella af ellu neemru besinay:
Missinay. mimmi shennigla besinay:
Lizkenim. sheheerichu yamim achare yehoshua. veotam hazzekenim lizkenim acherim ad shehiggiu litchillatam shel neviim shehen eli hakkohen ushemuel haramati:

Leanshe cheneset haggedola. mea veesrim zekenim hayu. zerubbavel seraya reelaya mardechay bilshan, shehayu bime ezra cheshealu min haggola bevayit sheni. umikkelalam, chaggay zecharya umalachi unechemya ben chachalya vechavrehem. venikreu keneset haggedola lefi shehecheziru haatara leyashnah (yoma 69:) shemmoshe amar (Devarim 10) hael haggadol haggibbor vehannora, bau yirmeya vedaniyyel velo amru gibbor venora, vehem hechezirum kevattechilla, lefi sheamru hen hen gevurotav hen hen norotav, sheilmale chen heach umma kazo yechola lehitkayyem bifne kamma ummot:
Hem amru shelosha devarim. harebe devarim amru, ella shelosha devarim hallalu amru [hen] sheyyesh bahem kiyyum hattora:
Hevu metunim baddin. sheim ba din lefanecha paam ushetayim veshalosh, lo tomar din ze kevar ba lefanay veshaniti veshillashti bo, ella hevu metunim, kelomar mamtinim kodem shettifseku haddin:

Vehaamidu talmidim harebe. laafoke merabban gamliel deamar (berachot koach.) kol talmid sheen tocho kevaro al yikkanes levet hammidrash, ka mashma lan shemmelammedin tora lechol adam veen tzarich livdok acharav, uvilvad shello yihye yadua meinyano shemmaasav mekulkalim vesane shumeaneh. i nammi ashmoinan (yevamot sav:) sheim heemid talmidim bevacharuto yaamid talmidim beziknuto, dichtiv (Kohelet 11) babboker zera zarecha velaerev al tannach yadecha:
Vaasu seyag lattora. gader shello yavo ligga beissur tora, kegon sheniyyot laarayot, ushevut leshabbat. dichtiv (Vayikra 18) ushemartem et mishmarti, asu mishmeret lemishmarti:

Hannoel bet habbad mippene habbaddadin. amme haaretz haosim melacha bevet habbad, vetiharan baal hazzetim kede sheyyaasu hashshemen betohora, venaal bet habbad bifnehem shello yikkansu amme haaretz lesham veshello yetzu hem veyittammeu bemagga amme haaretz chavrehem:
Vehayu sham. betoch bet habbad:
Kelim temein midras. shehen av hattuma umetammein adam ben bemagga ben bemassa ben behesset:
Rabbi meir omer bet habbad tame. dechayshinan shemma nitmeu bahen otan amme haaretz hattehorim vechazru vetimmeu et hakkol, deen choshshim lizzaher al hattuma:
Rabbi yehuda omer bet habbad tahor. denizharin al tumat vadday, hoil vechaver ze tiharan lechach:
Rabbi shimon omer im tehorim lahem. ellu hakkelim. kegon sheyyashva alehem eshet am haaretz o shehayu shel am haaretz, divenehen tehorin hen:
Bet habbad tame. sheen habbaddadim nizharim milligga bahen, veikka lemechash shemma nitmeu:
Veim temein hen. kegon sheyyadu sheyyashva alehen ishsha nidda o zava:
Bet habbad tahor. denizharin hen:

Amar rabbi yose. [rabbi yose] kerabbi meir sevira leh devet habbad tame, ella taama derabbi meir mishshum deen habbaddadin choshshim battuma, verabbi yose savar dechoshshin bemagga aval en bekiin behesset, vechoshvim shehen tehorin kol zeman shello nagu, hilkach bet habbad tame, dechayshinan shemma hissitu af al pi shello nagu bahem. vahalacha kerabbi yose:
Kol maase yom hakkippurim. kol avodot sheoved bevigde lavan bifnim uvahechol:
Haamur al hasseder. bemishnatenu:
Vechen bahechol. natan miktzat mattanot bapparochet venishpach haddam, yavi par acher veyatchil mattenot happarochet, veeno tzarich lachazor ulehatchil bifnim:
Shekkullan kappara bifne atzman. lefichach kappara shennigmera nigmera:
Mimmakom sheppasak. vaafillu lo nigmera otah kappara eno tzarich lachazor velitten ma shennatan. veen halacha kerabbi elazar verabbi shimon:
Yedichen. bemayim tzonnim:

Maase bevaytos ben zonin. matnitin chasure michassera vehachi katane, veim noten taam lifgam muttar, umaase nammi bevaytos ben zonin shehaya mevi gerogarot bisfina venishtabbera chavit shel yen nesech al gabbehen uva maase lifne chachamim vehittirum:
Kol shebbahanaato benoten taam. sheadam nehene mittaamo shel issur:
Kol sheen bahanaato benoten taam. sheeno nehene vetaamo shel issur:

Kegon chometz. shel issur shennafal betoch gerisin shel hetter, noten taam lifgam hu. vehu sheyyihyu haggerisin rotchin beshaa shennafal bahen hachometz, sheaz pogem bahem mittechilla vead sof. vearbaa mine notne taam hem, yesh taam mashbiach mittechilla vead sof, kegon hayyayin betavshil shel basar o shel dagim, veze asur issur vadday. veyesh taam pogem mittechilla vead sof, kegon shamnunit haddagim o habbasar bidvash, veze muttar lechattechilla. veyesh pogem mittechilla umashbiach bassof, kegon haddevash bayyayin shehu fogem bo leshato, uchesheyyishhe vo ad sheyyifgom alav koach hayyayin noten bo haddevash reach vetaam. veyesh mashbiach bitchilla ulevassof pogem, kegon shumman habbasar im hachema, o hattaam habbalua bichli sheeno ven yomo, shennichnas bo meshubbach veachar kach nifgam. veellu hashshenayim asurim missafek. lefichach im haggerisin hallalu shennafal bahen chometz lo hayu rotchin hare hen asurin missafek, shehachometz baggerisin makdiach umashbiach, veaf al pi cheshemmartichin achar kach pogem tamo, have mashbiach ulevassof pogem veasur:

Al tohoro. achar sheggamar kol hammattanot shel keranot mazze alav sheva peamim, kedichtiv (Vayikra 16) vehizza alav min haddam. tohoro, hammakom hamegulle shebbo, shechote haefer vehaggechalim elach veelach umazze al zehavo shel mizbeach:
Veshel mizbeach hachitzon. sheyare dam hachattaot hachitzonot haya shofech al yesod deromi:
Ellu vaellu. damim hachitzoniyyim vehappenimiyyim hannishpachim al mizbach haola, hayu shottim venoflim min hayyesod laritzpa umitarvin baamma silon shebbaazara hayyotze lenachal kidron:
Laggannanim. levaale ginnot:
Umoalin bahem. asur lehanot mehem belo damim:
Umayim bemayim. mayim shennitnassechu laavoda zara o shenneevdu, bemayim shel hetter:

Bechol shehu. lo shena nafal hettera lego issura o issura lego hettera, oser bemino bechol shehu. uvilvad sheyyihye haissur hannofel letoch hahetter nofel mikkeli sheppiv rachav veyesh bayyayin hayyotze min hakkeli shiur gadol bevat achat. aval hameare yen nesech mikkeli katan sheeno motzi ella tippa tippa venafal letoch yayin shel hetter, afillu chol hayyom kullo, amrinan kamma kamma vatil. veim era hetter letoch issur, kol ma sheera mimmennu letoch haissur, asur, vaafillu chavit melea letoch tippa achat. umaskana demilleta lefi hahalacha, kol issurin shebbattora ben beminan ben shello veminan, benoten taam. chutz mittevel veyen nesech, divminan bemashshehu, shello veminan benoten taam. yen nesech, mishshum chumra daavoda zara. vetevel, kehettero kach issuro, kemo shechitta achat poteret et hakkeri, kach chitta achat osa et hakkeri kullo tevel. veim issur mishshear issurin nitarev behetter, im nitarev min besheeno mino deikka lemekam attama, im teruma hi shennitarva vechullin yitamenna chohen, veim devar issur yitamennu nachtom nachri, im omer sheen battaarovet taam hatteruma o taam haissur, hakkol muttar. veim nitarev min bemino delekka lemekam attama, o min besheeno mino veen kan kohen o nachri shennuchal lismoch alav, im haissur hu mechelev vedam nevelot uterefot shekatzim uremasim vechayyotze vaze, meshaarin oto veshishshim, im yesh shishshim shel hetter keneged haissur hakkol muttar, veim lav, hakkol asur. veim haissur hu teruma vechalla uvikkurim, meshaarim oto bemea shel hetter. veim arla vechile hakkerem, meshaarin oto bematayim:

Haya mechatte veyored. hay tanna savar shehaya hakkohen holech beraglav lechol keren vekeren, vechol mattana umattana hayta bakkeren shellefanav vesamuch lo. ulehachi nakat mechatte veyored, kelomar shehaya noten mattana millemala lematta, sheim yitten millematta lemala bakkeren shellefanav haddam zav letoch bet yad shello umetannef et begadav. verabbi eliezer savar shehakkohen omed bekeren achat umishsham noten hammattanot al kol hakkeranot, shehare kol hammizbeach eno ella amma al amma merubba, vechevan sheen sheloshet hakkeranot semuchot lo yachol litten millematta lemala velo yetannef et begadav, chutz mikkeren zo shehu omed etzlah shei efshar lo letzadded rashe etzbeotav lematta ella lemala, sheim yetzadded rashe etzbeotav lematta veyitten mattana millematta lemala hare haddam zav letoch bet yad ketonet shello. veen halacha kerabbi eliezer:

Hameabbed bayyom umatza vayyom tahor. demissetama im haya adam motzo venogea bo haya magbiho, kederech motze aveda. aval ballayla, afillu shaa achat delo chazi leh, chayshinan shemma naga bo adam tame velo raahu. umatnitin birshut harabbim disfeko tahor ayre, veaf al pi chen ballayla temeim midras uteme met. aval birshut hayyachid disfeko tame, ben bayyom ben ballayla temeim. vehachi ita battosefta:
Birshut harabbim tehorim birshut hayyachid temein. deen kan ella safek shemma naga bahen nachri o am haaretz, hilkach birshut harabbim disfeko tahor, tehorim. birshut hayyachid disfeko tame, temeim:
Mippene shehunnach birshut am haaretz. vechol ma shebbevet am haaretz have teme met vetzarich hazzaa:
Ulehetiv et hannerot. hatava zo, hadelaka hi:
Ba lo chohen gadol likrot. parashat hayyom:
Bevigde vutz. sheavad bahem avodat hayyom:
Kore. shemmuttar lilbosh bigde kehunna afillu shello bishat avoda, devigde kehunna nittenu lehanot bahen:
Beitztelit. levush asuy kemin chaluk lavan,
Mishshello. shekkeriat happarasha enah avoda:
Chazzan hakkeneset. shammash:

Rosh hakkeneset. al piv nechtachim kol tzarche hakkeneset, mi maftir umi pores al shema umi over lifne hatteva. venotnim sefer tora mizze laze, mishshum yekara dechohen gadol, lehareot sheyyesh serarot harebe lematta mimmennu:

Omed umekabbel. mikkelal dead hasheta yoshev hava. nimtzenu lemedim divezrat nashim haya kore, dei beezrat yisrael vechol shekken bemakom hamekuddash yoter mimmenna asur leshev ella lemalche bet david huttar lahem leshev baazara, dichtiv (Shmuel 2 7) vayyavo hammelech david vayyeshev lifne Adonai:

Vekore achare mot veach beasor. shebbefarashat emor. shemmuttar ledalleg battora beinyan echad keshehu karov bichde shello yafsik hatturgeman, aval im kodem sheyyiglol sefer tora ad mekom haddillug yafsik hatturgeman hametargem pasuk shekkara hakkore, asur ledalleg veliglol, shennimtzeu tzibbur yoshvim umetzappim, veen ze kevod hatztzibbur:
Yoter mimma shekkariti lifnechem katuv kan. shello lehotzi laaz al sefer tora, kesheroin oto kore parasha shelishit al pe yihyu sevurim shessefer tora chaser otah parasha:

Uveasor shebbechummash happekudim kore al pe. shehi rechoka mipparashat achare mot veach beasor yoter mikkede sheyyafsik hatturgeman, lefichach eno yachol liglol sefer tora ad sham, lefi sheen gollim sefer tora betzibbur mippene kevod hatztzibbur, vesefer tora acher eno yachol lehavi, mishshum pegamo shel rishon, shello yomru harishon chaser hu:
Al hattora. shete berachot, achat lefaneha veachat leachareha, kederech shemmevarchin bevet hakkeneset:
Al haavoda veal hahodaa. retze umodim:
Veal mechilat heavon. selach lanu:
Veal hammikdash. shettishre vo shechina:
Veal hakkohanim. sheyyitbarchu veyihyu karbenotam leratzon:
Veal yisrael veal shear hattefilla. mefaresh baggemara, techinna rinna bakkasha millefanecha, sheammecha yisrael tzerichin lehivvasha, baruch atta Adonai‏ shomea tefilla:
Shesh maalot bammikvaot. mekomot shel kinnus mayim yesh bahen shesh maalot, kol achat mehen gedola mechavertah:
Me gevim. chafira shebbakkarka hamechunnasin bah mayim sheenan sheuvin, vehen pachot mearbaim sea shehu shiur mikve:
Gevim. leshon mayim miggeve (yeshaya 30):

Shata tame veshata tahor tame. im shata meotan hammayim tame techilla veachar kach shata mehen hattahor, nitma hattahor, lefi shennafla tippa mippiv shel tame letoch haggeve, veshemma shata otah hattahor venitma, dehashshote mashkin temeim posel et hatteruma. vehu mishshemona asar davar sheggazru bo vayyom kidita ferek kamma deshabbat. veaf al gav deeno fosel et hatteruma ella im ken shata reviit, mikkol makom keshebbaa hattippa hattemea vefiv, timmea chol hammashkin shebbefiv. veotah tippa lo salka la hashshaka vaggeve, demayre chesheen bo arbaim sea kidkatane vesefa. veal yede negiat hattame en me haggeve mittammeim ad sheyyittalshu. vehachi ita vattosefta:
Mille vichli tahor. min hammayim shebbaggeve leachar sheshshata vo hattame, dechayshinan leotah tippa kedifrishit, nitma hakkeli, shehakkelim mittammein bingiat mashkin temein:

Im hediach. et hakkikkar, tame, veim lav tahor, mippene sheen me gevain alulim lekabbel tuma ad sheyyittalshu, hilkach im lo hediach tahor, vaafillu cheshehigbiah hakkikkar lo huchshevu mayim shebbo lekabbel tuma min hattippa, shennitbattela hattippa vammayim hattehorim. aval keshehediach, huchshevu vehuchsheru mayim shebbeyadav lekabbel tuma min hattippa velo nitbattela vahen ella adderabba nitmeu vetimmeu et hakkikkar:
Haggomer et zetav. leachar sheavar zeman haggittot vehabbaddim. devishat haggittot vehabbaddim ha tenan bachagiga shehakkol neemanim al hatteruma bishat haggittot vehabbaddim:
Veshiyyer [tzarich lomar yeshayyer vechen hu bisfarim yeshanim]:

Kuppa achat. kede sheyyafrish mimmenna teruma umaaser betohora veyittenenna [leene hakkohen, shehakkohen] atzmo yire sheggamar atta et zetav, sheim lo yittenenna leene hakkohen, hu eno neeman lomar sheshshemaran betohora, kevan sheavar zeman haggittot vehabbaddim. veit sefarim degarse leani hakkohen, mishshum ditruma muetet kazo shemmafrishim leachar haggittot vehabbaddim en regilin latet otah ella lechohen ani, mishshum hachi tane kohen ani, vehu haddin dematze latet otah lechohen ashir:
Yolich lo et hammafteach miyyad. umehemninan leh bemay deamar sheatta gamar zetav:

Rabbi shimon omer meet leet. shel gemar lekitat hazzetim, im hevi lo et hammafteach, mehemninan leh. vahalacha kerabbi yehuda. uvetosefta (perek 10) mashma demiyyad dekaamar rabbi yehuda, hayenu kol oto hayyom:

Chetzyo kashar bassela vechetzyo kashar ben karnav. lo haya kosher kol hallashon shel zehorit bassela, shemma talbin miyyad kodem dechifat hassair, umissimchat libbun hallashon shel zehorit shemmare shekkevar nitkapperu haavonot yishkach mitzvat haddechifa vidamme shekkevar nishlema hammitzva meachar shehilbin hallashon. velo haya kosher kullah ben karnav, shemma bishat dechifa yachof hassair rosho tachat gufo kesheyyippol laachorav velo yuchal lirot hallashon keshettalbin, veyihyu kol yisrael atzevin. lefichach kashar chetzyah bassela, vehi lo talbin lachatzain ad shettigmor melechet kullah. ucheshekkosher baacharona chetzyah ben karnav, af al pi shettalbin miyyad lo yaniach milledachfo, hoil vehu asuk bah:

Ba veyashav lo. chozer ad sukka acharona. veaf al pi shehayyotze chutz lattechum afillu birshut chachamim en lo ella alpayim amma mimmakom sheyyatza lesham birshut, laze hittiru, lefi sheyyare laamod bammidbar mishshettechshach:
Metamme begadim. dichtiv (Vayikra 16) vehameshalleach et hassair laazazel yechabbes begadav:
Rabbi shimon omer kulei. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:

Kakkotevet. temara gassa. vehi pachot mikkabbetza. veaf al gav dechol shiure achila bichzayit, hayeynu mishshum dichtiv behu achila, aval hacha delo ketiv ella asher lo teunne gemire divvatzir mikkechotevet lo miyyatva dateh vehave meunne. umihu kayma lan dachatzi shiur asur min hattora, ella sheen chayyavin karet velo lokin ella al keshiur:
Kimlo lugmav. kol sheillu yesallekennu letzad echad yihye oto hatztzad bolet venire, nikra melo lugmav. veshiur ze beadam benoni hu pachot merviit:
Higgia sair lammidbar. sheeno rashshay lehatechil baavoda acheret ad sheyyaggia sair lammidbar, shenneemar (sham) veshillach et hassair bammidbar, veachar kach veet chelev hachattat yaktir:
Durekiot. avanim gedolot ugevohot zo al zo, sheshsham hashshomrim omdim umenifim besudarin:
Vead bet chiddudo. hu rosh hammidbar. usevira leh lerabbi yehuda shemmishshehiggia hassair sham naaset mitzvato, af al pi shello higgia latztzuk. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Holchin mil. kidamrinan leel miyyakkire yerushalayim melavvin oto ad sukka rishona, ucheshechozrin veshohin achar kach kede hilluch mil kevar yadu shehiggia sair lammidbar:
Kevan shehichnisan lirshut hammeara. shettovlim bah. kemo borot shichin umearot:
Dayyo. velo chayshinan shemma lo yitbolu o lo yatbilu hakkelim veyomru tavalnu vehitbalnu:
Tzarich laamod alehen. lefi sheen bekiin bedin tevila vachatzitza:
Tehorim lahem. kegon kelim shel am haaretz acher, shebbeenehem hen kelim tehorim lefi sheen nizharim mimmagga am haaretz. verabbi shimon letaameh kidfareshna leel. vahalacha kerabbi yose:

Naflu alehen mashkin temein. leachar shennigmera melachtan vehuchsheru lekabbel tuma, hare kol hazzetim temein vaafillu otan shello nagu bahen hammashkin hattemein, shehammashke sheyyatza mehen leachar shennigmera melachtan sheal yado huchsheru lekabbel tuma hu mitarev beellu hammashkin hattemein umekabbel tuma mehen, umetamme achar kach kol shear hazzetim:
Hammochal hayyotze mehen. min hazzetim shennigmera melachtan:
Rabbi eliezer metaher. dela chashiv mochal mashke lo lehacheshir hazzeraim velo lekabbel tuma kishar mashkim:
Vachachamim metammein. demochal chashuv mashke ben lehacheshir ben letamme, kesheyyotze min hazzetim leachar shennigmera melachtan:

Hammochal hayyotze min habbor. leachar shemmotziin hashshemen min habbor, nishar bekarkait habbor mochal kemo mayim. vekaamar rabbi shimon daaleh ifligu rabbi eliezer verabbanan, rabbi eliezer la chashiv leh mashke, verabbanan savre kevan delo efshar lihyot mochal bekarkait habbor belo tzichtzuche shemen, chashive mashke kemo hashshemen. vahalacha kachachamim, uchemo shepperesh pelugetayhu tanna kamma, velo kemo shepperesh rabbi shimon:
Harechek mishshachen ra. shello tilmod mimmaasav. veod, shello tilke immo bemappalto, deoy larasha veoy lishcheno:

Veal titchabber larasha. shekkach amru chachamim, kol hammitdabbek larshaim af al pi sheeno ose kemaasehem notel sachar kayyotze bahem. lema haddavar dome, lenichnas leveto shel buresi, af al pi shello lakach mimmennu kelum, mikkol makom reach ra kalat vehotzi immo:

Veal tityaesh min happuranut. shello tomar rasha ze maasav matzlichin elech veeddavek immo hoil vehashshaa mesacheket lo, lechach amar veal tityaesh min happuranut, kelomar da shemmehera tavo alav puranut ki pitom yavo edo:

Bechol yom olin bemizracho shel kevesh. deamar mar kol pinnot sheatta pone lo yehu ella derech yamin, shehu lammizrach, shehare hakkevesh baddarom, lechach olin bemizracho shel kevesh, shessamuch lifnot leyamin:
Vehayyom kohen gadol. mishshum kevodo, lehareot chashivuto shehu keven bayit veholech bemakom shehu chafetz, ma sheen shear kohanim rashshain laasot ken:
Hammanniach yeno vekaron o visfina. im hannachri:
Bekappandarya. bederech ketzara, shennichnas beshaar ze veyotze mishshaar shekkenegdo:
Verachatz. bammerchatz:

Muttar. dechevan denachri lo yada deshahe, mirtat velo naga. veashmoinan bematnitin pelugta derabban shimon ben gamliel verabbanan behanach telata bave, dei tana nachri shehaya maavir kadde yayin, hava amena hatam mirtat hannachri desavar hasheta ate chaze li, aval bisfina vekaron maflig leh lisfinteh vaavid may devae velo mirtat. vei tana sefina vekaron velo tane hammanniach nachri vachanuto, hava amena bisfina vekaron mirtat desavar dilma veorcha acharina azel vekae mitztzad acher vechaze li, aval bemanniach nachri vachanuto deikka lememar ached leh levava vaavid kol devae, ema lo, tzericha. uvechullehu halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel:
Ba lo etzel sair. leachar sheggamar mattan damim shel par vesair ba lo hakkohen etzel sair hammishtalleach bammakom sheheemido sham keneged bet shillucho:
Venitteza tzinnora. nittaz rok mippiv shel am haaretz hamedabber, verok hayyotze mippi am haaretz metamme adam vechelim midderabbanan, vechol shekken ochalim umashkim:

Sefeko tahor. deamrinan sefat habbor kalta hatztzinnora umenaatta millaredet letoch hayyayin. umatnitin ayre bevor sid sheeno mekabbel tuma. uvetosefta amru, divvor shel shemen tame, lefi shehashshemen machalik sefat habbor [vehatztzinnora] machleket veyoredet lematta lashshemen shebbabbor:

Veheve zahir bidvarecha. shello yomar haddayyan shemma kach vechach haya maase, o im haya haddavar kach haya peloni zakkay, umittoch devarim hallalu lomed baal haddin o haedim lomar davar shello haya:

Beellu nishalim. kohen hannishal beurim vetummim tzarich lilbosh shemona begadim. vechetzad shoalim beurim vetummim. hashshoel panav achore hakkohen hannishal, vehannishal panav kelappe haaron, vehashshoel omer haeese davar peloni o lo eese. veeno shoel bekol ram velo mehareher belibbo, ella bekol namuch. veruach hakkodesh loveshet et hakkohen umabbit bachoshen, veroe otiyyot boltot bachoshen keneged panav, ase kach o lo taase kach, lefi shehayu ketuvim al avne hachoshen shemot shel shenem asar shevatim veavraham yitzchak veyaakov veshivte yah, nimtzet kol haalfa beta sham, veruach hakkodesh hayta modia lakkohen ech yetzaref haotiyyot habboltot zo im zo, ad sheyyavin mashmautan shel haddevarim:

Ella lammelech vechulei. dichtiv (Bamidbar 27) velifne elazar hakkohen yaamod vegomer, hu, ze melech, vechol bene yisrael itto, mi shekkol bene yisrael itto latzet lammilchama, acharav, ze meshuach milchama, [dehaynu] lemi shetztzorech hatztzibbur bo, vechol haeda, ellu sanhedri gedola:

Yom hakkippurim asur baachila uvishtiyya. af al gav devaachila ushetiyya anush karet, mishshum devae lemitne shear innuyin delet behu karet tana asur. vehane chamishsha innuyin keneged chamishsha innuyin hakketuvim battora, deshabbat shabbaton deemor el hakkohanim, veshabbat shabbaton deachare mot, uveasor lachodesh dechummash happekudim, veach beasor lachodesh deemor el hakkohanim, vehayta zot lachem lechukkat olam deachare mot, bechullehu ketiv teannu veinnitem. vehane dematnitin nammi chamishsha innuyin ninhu, dishtiyya vaachila achat hen:
Hammelech. tzarich sheyyitrae nae, dichtiv (yeshaya log) melech beyafyo techezena enecha:
Vehakkalla. tzericha noy kede lechabbevah al baalah. vechol sheloshim yom keruya kalla:
Vehechaya. yoledet:
Tinol. mippene hatztzinna:
Divre rabbi eliezer. akkullehu kae, ammelech vechalla vechayya. vahalacha kerabbi eliezer:
Kele tashmish. shel seudda. vedavka chele mattechet o chele cheres hametzuppim baavar. uchele zechuchit kichle mattachot dame:
Et sheddarko lehatebil. kelomar keli harauy littaher bitvila veeno tzarich tikkun acher, kegon shettashmisho al yede tzonen:
Yatbil. bemikve hakkasher litvilat ishsha, utevilato mattirato:
Lehageil. kegon yorot ukederot shel mattechet shettashmishan al yede rotchin:

Yagil. berotchin. shemmachnisan letoch yora melea mayim rotchin umashhin otan betochah meat. veze achar shemmeshafshefan umesir hachaludda shellahen. veachar kach matbilan bemikve hakkasher litvilat ishsha vehen muttarin:
Lelabben. kelim shemmishtammeshim bahen al yede haur beyavesh beli rotev, kedimfaresh veazel, kegon hashshappudim vehaaskelaot:
Melabbenan baur. ad sheyyihyu nitztzotzot nittazin mehen, veachar kach matbilan vehen muttarin:

Shafah. noatzah bekarka kasha eser peamim, im en bah gummot, veochel bah tzonen. o mashchizah beeven hammashchezet shellah, veochel bah afillu rotchin. veim hayu vah gummot, melabbenah. vechullan shennishtammesh bahen ad shello hirtiach, o ad shello hilbin, vead shello hitbil, muttar:

Al taas atzmecha cheorche haddayyanin. keotan anashim sheorchim umesadderim taanot baale haddin lifne haddayyanim. sheasur laadam legallot dino leechad mibbaale haddin velomar lo ase kach bishvil shettizke bedincha, veaf al pi sheyyodea shehaddin immo. perush acher, keorche haddayyanin, kigdole haddayyanin. uvetalmid hayyoshev lifne rabbo medabber, shello yaase atzmo kigdole haddayyanim ledabber lifne rabbo kefosek et haddin. orche, leshon arkaot shel nachrim (gittin 9:), arkaot shel bet david. umippi acherim shamati, al taas atzmecha kigdole haddayyanim lachof baale dinim sheyyavou laddin lefanecha:
Yihyu veenecha chirshaim. shello yatte libbecha leechad mehem lomar ish peloni chashuv hu velo yiton taanat sheker. sheim atta omer ken, en atta roe lo chova:

Keshekkibbelu alehem et haddin. shello tachshod hachayyav lomar gazlan haya ze, ella tomar shemma toe haya velo nitkavven ligzol. i nammi, nitchayyev echad mehem shevua venishba, lo tomar lashsheker nishba:
Ten lanu et dameha. deha lo kanu, vehu eno chayyav lahem ella maot:

Hammocher yeno lenachri pasak immo maot: ad shello madad. damav muttarin. dimshicha venachri kona chemo veyisrael, ucheshemmoded hayyisrael bechelav uva hakkeli virshut hannachri kenao hannachri vimshicha, vahavu leh layyisrael zuze etzel hannachri behalevaa, veyen nesech lo have ad denaga:
Madad ad shello fasak. sechum haddamim, kach vechach yayin bechach vechach damim:

Damav asurin. denachri lo kanye hasheta vimshicha, dechevan delo fasak damav lo samcha dateh delikneyeh bimshicha, shemma yarbe lo damav, hilkach ki naga beh have yen nesech birshut yisrael, sheadayin lo kenao hannachri ad sheyyifsok lo damim:
Im yesh bo akkevet yayin. im yesh bammashpech shennimdad bo techilla yayin shel nachri, akkevet yayin, oganim shemmitakkev yayin al piv shello yatza chetippa o shete tippin:
Asur. demittesar chamra deyisrael mishshum hahi tippat yen nesech shebbammashpech:
Hameare mikkeli el keli. yisrael sheera mikkeli shello lakkeli shebbeyad hannachri o lichli sheyyesh bo yen nesech:
Et shemmeare mimmennu muttar. hayyayin shennishar bakkeli haelyon shebbeyad yisrael, muttar:

Veet sheera vetocho. vehakkilluach sheyyatza mikkeli yisrael af al pi shello higgia lakkeli shebbeyad hannachri, vechol shekken ma shehiggia lakkeli shel nachri, asur, denitztzok chibbur. umatnitin deshare hayyayin shennishar bakkeli shebbeyad yisrael, mayre kegon dakattaf kattofe, shekkodem shennaga hakkilluach bakkeli hattachton shebbeyad hannachri pasak haelyon hamechubbar lakkeli shebbeyad yisrael, velo haya chan nitztzok sheyyechabber ma shebbakkeli haelyon lema shebbakkeli hattachton. i nammi, denafatz nappotze, shehishlich hayyayin min hakkeli haelyon kederech shemmashlichin min hammizrakim, velo haya sham silon vekilluach sheyyechabber ben hayyayin shebbakkeli asher beyad yisrael lakkeli shebbeyad nachri. aval im haya sham chibbur, kol ma shennishar bakkeli haelyon shebbeyad yisrael asur, dekayma lan nitztzok chibbur veoser beyen nesech. vechen hilchata:

Vechevesh. kemin maala asu, shehu gavoah veyotze derech hakkevesh chutz laazara vechutz lair, kede shello yuchelu habbavliyyim ligga bamshalleach, lefi shehayu regilin letalsho bisaro veomrim lo tol maher vetze veal tashhe avonotenu etzlenu od:
Miyyakkire yerushalayim. mechashuve yerushalayim:
Ad sukka rishona. sukkot asu lo badderech, veholchin bene adam lagur sham lifne yom hakkippurim, shemmelavvin oto missukka lesukka:
Tishim ris. hayu mirushalayim vead hatztzuk. kol har gavoah vezakuf karuy tzuk:

Shiva umechetza. risin lechol mil. ani shamati derus garsinan bevav. vehem matayim veshishshim veshesh pesiot, kecheshbon rus. nimtzeu shiva risin umechetza alpayim pesiot pachot chamishsha, karov lemiddat techum shabbat, vetishim ris hem shenem asar mil:
Lammakom shennichnas. bevet kodesh hakkadashim:
Bammakom sheamad. ben habbaddim:
Velo haya mitkavven lehazzot lo lemala. shettehe achat lemala bechuddah shel kapporet haelyon vehashsheva lematta [beavyah], shehare lo al hakkapporet nogim ella laaretz noflim:
Ella chematzlif. kammalke hazze shemmatchil ben hakketefayim veyored lematta, kach haya mitkavven sheyyihyu shemone hazzaot hallalu baaretz kashshura, zo tachat zo:

Achat veachat. sheim lo yimne hazzaa rishona shellemala leatzmah im kol sheva shellematta, peamim sheyyite veyimne hazzaa rishona im sheva shellematta, uvahazzaa harishona shellematta yimne shetayim. veen lomar yimne hazzaa shellemala im sheva shellematta veyimne ad shemone, deyesh lomar mitzva lehafesik mattanot shellematta mittoch shiva velo mittoch shemona:
Ba lo. achar shemmasar kohen gadol hassair hammishtalleach lamshalleach, ba lo etzel par vesair haomdim lissaref, ukeraan vehotzi emurehen:
Unetanam bemages. bikara shel kele sharet:

Vehiktiram. i efshar lomar shehaya maktiran achshav, deha bevigde lavan hu lavush vaadayin alav likrot happarasha bevigde lavan. ella hachi kaamar, netanam bemages kede lehaketiran achar kach kesheyyaggia zemannan, leachar sheyyitbol veyilbash bigde zahav:
Kelaan bemiklaot. kemin kelia, ushelemim hem im orotam uvesaram ufirsham, ella shennikra keresam lehotzi emurehen:
Vehotzian levet hasserefa. chutz lirushalayim:
Umeematay metammein begadim. haasukin bahem, kedichtiv (Vayikra 16) vehassoref otam yechabbes begadav:
Rabbi shimon omer kulei. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
Ushetiyya hayta nikret. al shem shemmimmenna nishtat haolam, shebbah yasad hakkadosh baruch hu et olamo. shetiyya, yesod:
Yose ven yoezer ish tzereda veyose ven yochanan ish yerushalayim. kol hattannaim hannizkarim beferek ze zug zug peloni ufeloni kibbelu mippeloni ufeloni, harishon mehem nasi vehashsheni av bet din:

Yehi vetcha vet vaad lachachamim. kesheyyirtzu hachachamim lehitkabbetz ulehivvaed, yihye betcha muchan ledavar ze, sheyyihyu regilim lomar nitkabbetz babbayit shel peloni. shei efshar shello tilmod mehem eze devar chachma. mashlu mashal lema haddavar dome, lenichnas lachanuto shel bassam, af al pi shello lakach kelum, mikkol makom reach tov kalat vehotzi immo:

Veheve mitabbek baafar raglehem. kelomar shettelech acharehem. shehamehallech maale avak beraglav, vehaholech acharav mitmalle meavak shehu maale beraglav. perush acher, shetteshev leraglehem al haaretz. shekkach hayu nohagim, sheharav yoshev al hassafsal vehattalmidim yoshvim leraglav al gabbe karka:
Veheve shote vetzama et divrehem. keadam tzame sheshshote leteavon, velo keadam savea shekkatz bimzono shemmoes afillu bidvarim haarevim vetovim:

Umashkin temein betoch bet habbad. vehen nishpachim al gabbe karka vedorchim habbaddadim alehen venidbakim beraglehen, vechozrim otan mashkin umetammeim et hazzetim keshehabbaddadin olim vedorchim al gabbe hazzetim, ella im ken yesh ben hammashkin lazzetim aretz kede sheyyenaggevu raglehen min hammashkin hattemeim al yede derisatam baaretz. uchesheen minalim beraglehen ayre, deha mashke metamme keli vechozer umetamme mashkin sheim hazzetim. aval kesheen minalim beraglehen venitnaggevu hammashkin hattemein shebberaglehen al yede derisatan baaretz, shuv en mittammeim hazzetim kesheddorchin otan, demashkin temein metammein kelim veen metammein adam:

Habbaddadin vehabbotzrin. ha delo nakat hammoskin vehabbotzrin, lefi sheggazru al habbetzira shettease betohora, velo gazru al hammesika. vetaama meforash beferek kamma deshabbat, sheppeamim adam holech lecharmo leda im higgiu anavav livtzor im lav, venotel eshkol shel anavim vesochato umezallef al gabbe anavim uvishat betzira adayin mashke tofeach alehen vehuchsheru lekabbel tuma. vetaam ze lo shayyach bimsika:
Neemanin lomar lo naganu. uchegon dechaver omed immahen bevet habbad. velo chayshinan dilma nagu velav addateh dechaver:

Hattinokot. baddadim sheheviu benehen immahen vetiharum lechach, uchesherotzin benehem lippanot yotzim avihen lachutz immahem venifnim achore haggader, velo chayshinan dilma naga betuma velav addata dechaver:
Kol hameyuchad lemaachal adam. kegon setam ochalin:
Tame. tumat ochalin ad sheyyippasel meachilat hakkelev:
Ad sheyyeyachadennu laadam. deyesh chilluk ben appoke tuma minneh, laatoye leh tuma:

Gozal shennafal legat. keshello nafal laggat lo pelige rabbi yochanan ben nuri verabbanan, denivlat of tahor bakkerakkim lo baya machashava leshauoya ochel, mishshum deikka rov am habbaim lashshuk veachle nivlat of tahor. uvakkefarim delekka rov am bae machashava, kidfareshna beresh perek kamma. ki felige keshennafal laggat umet bakkerakkim, rabbanan savre af al gav devakkerakkim lo bae machashava, hecha denafal laggat measattu gitto veeno rauy uvae machashava. verabbi yochanan ben nuri savar lo measattu gitto vahare hu kishar nivlat of tahor delo baya machashava bakkerakkim. veen halacha kerabbi yochanan ben nuri:
Chishshav alav cheresh shote vekatan. lehaachilo lenachri:
Gamar millimsok. millilkot zetav:
Aval atid likkach. liknot zetim min hashuk ulehosif al ellu:
Gamar millikkach. sheen bedato liknot od zetim, aval rotze lilvot zetim meacherim ulehosif al ellu:
Ero evel o mishte. ulefichach lo hosif alehen, aval dato lehosif kesheyyaavor haevel:
Tehorin. lefi shello huchsheru. kerabban gamliel deamar mishshettiggamer melachtan:

En tame ella mekom maggaan. en muchshar ella mekom nefilat hammashke. perush acher, naflu al hazzetim hallalu shello nigmera melachtan mashkin temein, lo nitma mehen ella hazzetim shennagu bahen hammashkin temeim bilvad:

Hammochal hayyotze mehen. hammayim hayyotzim min hazzetim kodem shennigmera melachtan en lahen din mashkin, veen machshirin et hoochalin, vehen atzman en mekabbelin tuma. umippene ma tahor hammochal hayyotze min hazzetim ad shello nigmera melachtan, lefi sheeno rotze bekiyyuman:
Shennafal levor. shel yayin:

Kullo asur bahanaa. shehayyayin shennitnassech laavoda zara oser bemino bechol shehu. aval setam yenam shel nachrim shello yadanu vo shennitnassach vadday, af al pi sheasur bahanaa eno oser taaravto bahanaa, ella nimkar kullo lenachri chutz middeme oto setam yenan. vechen halacha:
Hammafkid kelim etzel am haaretz temeim teme met. utzerichin hazzaa shelishi ushevii:
Im makkiro. im haam haaretz makkir bammafkid shehu kohen ochel batteruma, zahir al happikkadon shello shello yetammeennu bemet, veeno tzarich hazzaa:
Aval temein midras. mishshum ishto nidda shemma yashva alehen, deeno nizhar mittumat ishto:
Bizman shehi rotzetzet. shehakkissuy dochek habbegadim mechamat shehi melea beyoter:
Temeim midras. habbegadim. dichsheishto yoshevet al hatteva o nishenet aleha, machbedet al habbegadim:
Im enah rotzetzet temein maddaf. kelomar tuma kalla, letamme ochalin umashkin, kemo al gabbo shel zav sheeno metamme begadim:
Af al pi shehammafteach beyad bealim. dechayshinan shemma hissita:
Bechol yom hayu sham. bammizbeach hachitzon:

Arba maarachot. shel etzim shemmevaarim alehem haesh, achat maaracha gedola shemmakrivin aleha hattamid, veachat maaracha sheniyya shemmimmenna notlim esh lemizbach hakketoret, veachat maaracha shel kiyyum haesh shello tasur mishsham esh leolam, veachat maaracha shel evarim ufedarim shel tamid shel ben haarbayim shello nitakkelu mibbaerev velo nisrefu kol hallayla, sorfin otam bemaaracha zo. umosifin beyom hakkippurim od maaracha achat littol mimmenna gechalim lakketoret lifnay velifnim:

Rabbi yose omer bechol yom shalosh. dishlosha kerae chetive, (Vayikra 6) al mokdah al hammizbeach kol hallayla ad habboker, zo maaracha gedola. (sham) veesh hammizbeach tukad bo, zo maaracha sheniyya shel ketoret. (sham) vehaesh al hammizbeach tukad bo lo tichbe, zo maaracha shelishit shel kiyyum haesh. umaaracha reviit leevarim ufedarim shello nitakkelu let leh lerabbi yose, disvira leh sheevarim ufedarim shello nitakkelu, betzidde maaracha gedola hem nisrafim:

Rabbi yehuda omer bechol yom shetayim. delet leh maaracha shelishit shel kiyyum haesh. umikra shelishi shel vehaesh al hammizbeach tukad bo lo tichbe daresh leh rabbi yehuda shehammavir kismim dakkim kede lehatztzit haesh al hammaaracha haggedola lo yatztzit al haritzpa veyaalem keshehem dolkim lammizbeach, ella yadlikem berosh hammizbeach. vahalacha kerabbi yose:
Eno chayyav ella chattat echat. demechad kera nafke achila ushetiyya, vechad shema hu:
Achal veasa melacha. mittere kerae nafke, utere shemot ninhu:
Zetim meematay mekabbelin tuma. lihyot muchsharim bashshemen hayyotze mehen:
Zeat hammaatan. keli shennotnim bo et hazzetim vehen nichmarot sham kede sheyyihyu reuyim lehotzi shemen. leshon atinav malu chalav [iyyov ka]:

Aval lo zeat hakkuppa. dekuppa enah machazeket hammashkin, vehammashke hayyotze mehen holech leibbud, velo nicha leh, veen machshir hazzeraim lekabbel tuma ella mashke denicha leh, dichtiv (Vayikra 11) vechi yuttan mayim al zera, ketiv yitten vekarinan yuttan, yuttan dumeya deyitten, ma yitten denicha leh af yuttan denicha leh:

Shiur zea shelosha yamim. demashke hayyotze toch shelosha eno chashuv shemen ella mochal bealma veeno machshir, sheen machshirim lekabbel tuma ella shiva mashkin bilvad, vehen yayin mayim shemen devash chalav tal dam:
Mishsheyyitchabberu shelosha ze laze. derech hazzetim mitchabberim ze laze kesheshshahu bammaatan:

Mishshettiggamer melachtan. melechet hachenasatan. dechol zeman sheddato lehavi od zetim mimmakom acher lehosif al ellu, en hazzea machshiratan, mishshum delo nicha leh. umishshettiggamer melachtan, afillu ben yomo machshir. vahalacha kerabban gamliel, shechachamim omrim kidvarav:

Shemaya veavtalyon. gere tzedek hayu, umibbene banav shel sancheriv hem. veshamati shemmippene shehaya avtalyon av bet din nikra beshem ze, shepperusho av lakketannim. ki talya bilshon arammi, katan, kemo (Megila 5:) amar rav yochanan kad havena talya, keshehayiti katan. letu talya vetalyata (yevamot 114.) yaviu katan uketanna. af kan avtalyon avihen shel yetomim ketannim:
Ehov et hammelacha. afillu yesh lo bema lehitparnes, chayyav laasok bimlacha. shehabbattala mevia lide shiamum (ketuvot 59:):

Usena et harabbanut. velo tomar adam gadol ani ugenay li laasok bimlacha, deamar leh rav lerav kahana (fesachim 113.), peshot nevelta bashshuk vetol agra, velo tema kahana ana gavra rabba ana vesanya bi milleta. perush acher, usena et harabbanut, hitrachek millinhog serara al tzibbur, sheharabbanut mekabberet et bealeha:

Veal titvadda larashut. kede littol rabbanut al yadeha. i nammi, al titvadda larashut, shello yaavirucha al daat koncha, kemo sheera ledoeg haadomi. larashut, hasserara keruya rashut, mippene sheharshut beyadah laasot kirtzonah:
Shehi ketafres. shetztziddah echad namuch keen midron:
Umashke tofeach millemattan. batztzad hannamuch, vehayenu batzek shebbelilatah rakka umashke shellah tofeach, aval millemala belilatah ava veen mashke tofeach:
Shalosh chatichot. ben shelashtan kabbetza, achat tofeach ushetayim enan tofeach, sedurot zo etzel zo, vehattofachat millematta, vehasheta haemtzait nogaat battofachat, vehaelyona nogaat baemtzait:

Enan mitztarfot. lechabbetza letamme hammashke tofeach shellematta veyachazor hammashke vitamme et haareva, dingia enah mechabberet et habbatzek, ella im ken noshchot keditnan beferek kamma (mishna 7) mikratzot noshchot zo et zo:

Shetayim mitztarfot. im lo hayu ella shete chatichot batzek, hattachtona sheyyesh bah mashke tofeach veshellemala hemenna hannogaat bah, uven shetehen kabbetza, mitztarfot letamme hammashke veyachazor vitamme et haareva:
Afillu shetayim en mitztarfin ella im ken hayu rotztzot mashke. leolam en mashke mechabber ad sheyyihye mashke dochek veomed ben shete hachatichot. veen halacha kerabbi yose:

Veim haya mashke omed. kelomar im lo haya ketafres ella eshboren, vehammashke omed ben chatichot habbatzek, afillu kol shiur habbetza shebbabbatzek perurim dakkin keen hachardal meforadim ze mizze, hammashke sheomed mechabberan umitztarfin lechabbetza, umetammein hammashke vechozer hammashke umetamme et haareva:
Ochel parur. ochel shehu chaluk leferurim perurim dakkin eno mitztaref, deen hammashke mechabberan. veen halacha kerabbi dosa:

Hannoten min hassallim umin hammashteach shel adama. anavim shebbetzaran mittechilla laachila, velo huchsheru lekabbel tuma, delo gazru ella al habbotzer mittechilla laggat veachar kach nimlach alehen ulekachan min hassallim o min haadama sheshshatach haanavim aleha unetanan laggat:
Bet shammay omrim noten beyadayim tehorot. kevan shebba lenatnan laggat hare hu keillu betzaran mittechilla laggat, vetzarich sheyyitten laggat betohora:

Veim natan beyadayim temeot timmean. veaf al gav distam yadayim sheniyyot hen, veen sheni ose shelishi bechullin, dilma kasavre hattevulim litruma kitruma damu. i nammi, beyadayim techillot askinan, verabbi shimon ben elazar hi kidita perek 2‏ dechullin:
Uvet hillel omrim noten laggat beyadayim temeot umafrish terumato betohora. lefi shello huchsheru kevan divtzaran mittechilla laachila:

Min haavat umin hammashteach shel alim. avit hu keli shennotnim bo haanavim keshebbotzrim otan laggat. umashteach shel alim, sheshshatchu healim al pene haadama venatnu haanavim alehem. vehasheta mochcha milleta dehabbotzer anavim hallalu mittechilla, laggat betzaran velo laachila, hilkach shavim bet shammay uvet hillel beha denoten beyadayim tehorot, deha shatik leh hillel leshammay beferek kamma deshabbat vehoda lo shehabbotzer laggat huchshar:

Ase lecha rav. rambam peresh, af al pi sheeno rauy lihyot lecha rav, ase oto rav alecha velo tilmod bencha leven atzmecha. vaani shamati, ase lecha rav, sheyyekabbel lo rav echad sheyyilmod mimmennu tamid, velo yilmod hayyom meechad ulemachar min haacher. veaf al gav divmassechet avoda zara (daf 19) amru hallomed tora merav echad eno roe siman beracha, kevar pershu veamru hane mille bisvara, shettov lo lishmoa sevarat harabbim, aval leinyan gemara, mechad rav mealle, ki hechi delo lifgom lishaneh:
Ukene lecha chaver. vaafillu atta tzarich liknoto bedamim yekarim ulefazzer alav mamon kede shettikne ahavato. aval berav lo shayyach lomar kene lecha rav, sheharav tzarich lelammed bechinnam:

Veheve dan et kol haadam lechaf zechut. keshehaddavar bechaf moznayim veen lo hechrea lechan ulechan, kegon adam sheen anu yodim mimmaasav im tzaddik im rasha veasa maase sheefshar leduno lizchut veefshar leduno lechova, middat chasidut hi leduno lechaf zechut. aval adam shehuchzak berasha, muttar leduno lechova, shello amru ella hachoshed bichsherim loke begufo (shabbat 97.), mikkelal shehachoshed birshaim eno loke:
Barechayim. shennotnim bahen zetim kodem netinatan levet habbad veachar kach notnan bevet habbad vetoanan bekora:
Veim haya mashke. nitma hammashke bashsheretz venitmeu kol hazzetim al yede chibbur mashke:
Nimtza al gabbe healim. nimtza hashsheretz al gabbe healim hamechassim et hazzetim, vealim lav bar kabbole tuma ninhu:
Yishshaalu habbaddadim. amme haaretz shettiharan baal hashshemen laasot zetav betohora, veneemanim lomar lo naganu bashsheretz sheal healim velo nitmenu:
Veim haya nogea baom. im haya hashsheretz yotze min healim shemmechassim et hazzetim venogea baom:
Afillu. sear echad min hashsheretz nogea baom:
Tame. kol haom, dachashiv chibbur. om, hazzetim hamekubbatzim yachad umechubbarin ze baze bammaatan, nikraim om:
Hassocher et happoel laasot immo veyen nesech. lahariko mikkeli el keli, o leholich chaviyyot mimmakom lemakom. vaafillu vistam yenam:
Secharo asur. kenas hu shekkansu chachamim beyen nesech uvistam yenam:
Secharo muttar. uchegon sheamar lo haaver li kol chavit vechavit bifruta. aval im amar lo haaver li mea chaviyyot bemea ferutot, venimtzet chavit shel yen nesech benehem, secharo asur:

Hassocher et hachamor secharah asur. ha matnitin nakat leh mishshum sefa, vesefa ata leashmoinan deaf al gav dehassocher et hachamor lirkov alav setama secharah nammi lehanniach legino shel yayin umezonotav aleha, salka datach amena dahave cheillu secharah meikkara lehavi aleha yen nesech usecharo asur, kamashma lan:

Natal dam happar vehinniach dam hassair. maskana demilleta derabbi yehuda hi, deamar lo haya sham ella kan echad, vetzarich littol dam happar techilla kede lehaniach dam hassair bakkan shehaya alav dam happar. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Al happarochet. dichtiv (Vayikra 16) vechen yaase leohel moed:
Era dam happar. dichtiv bemattenot hammizbeach (sham) velakach middam happar umiddam hassair, middam shenehem yachad:
Venatan et hammale varekan. vechozer umeare mizrak male toch harekan, kede sheyyitarvu haddamim yafe yafe:

Achore chelim shennitmeu vemashkim. hay denakat achore kelim, mishshum dekillu, shekkeli shennitmeu achorav bemashkin temein, achorav temein, tocho aznav oganav veyadav tehorin, mishshum detumat mashkim letamme kelim midderabbanan hekellu vah. aval im nitma tocho bemashkin temein, nitma kullo:
Metammeim et hammashkin. afillu dechullin:
Veen poslin et hoochalin. vaafillu ditruma:

Rabbi yehoshua omer metammein et hammashkin ufoslin et hoochalim. rabbi yehoshua yalef (benidda daf 7:) daachore kelim poslim ochale teruma kal vachomer mittevul yom, ma tevul yom sheeno metamme et hammashkin, delo gazru rabbanan al tevul yom sheyyehe metamme et hammashkin, afillu hachi posel ochalim shel teruma, dichtiv (Vayikra 22) uva hashshemesh vetaher veachar yochal min hakkodashim, eno tahor leechol batteruma ad sheyyaariv shimsho, dikra bitruma mishtae. achore kelim shemmetammein et hammashkin, eno din sheyyehu poslin et hatteruma. verabbi eliezer delo chayesh lehay kal vachomer, mishshum daachore kelim shennitmeu bemashkin derabbanan, utevul yom deorayta, uderabbanan middeorayta en danin kal vachomer:
Shimon achi azarya. lefi sheazarya asak bifrakmatya vehaya mesappek mazon leshimon achiv sheyyaasok battora, lefichach nikra al shem azarya achiv:

Lo chach velo chach. lo metammein mashke chullin velo poslin ochale teruma, aval metammein mashke teruma, veotan mashkin shel teruma metammein echad beochale teruma shennaasu sheniyyim, veotan ochalim poslim ochalim acherim shel teruma. vehayenu dekaamre hoochalim shel teruma lemashkin shel teruma, metammeecha lo timmeuni, kelomar achore keli hammetammeecha lo timmeuni, delo pasle ochale teruma, veatta timmetani. vahalacha kerabbi eliezer:
Balleshet. chayil shemmechappesin vechotrin habbattim. targum vaychappes, uvalash:

Ratza littol mehem bad echad. zetim shello nigmera melachtan velo huchsheru, kegon shehaya dato likkach ulehosif alehen keditnan beresh pirkin, uva likkach mehen shiur muat shemmesimim bevet habbad befaam achat, o shene baddin, velaasot mehen shemen, umashir mehen bammaatan harebe:
Bet shammay omrim kotze vetuma. chotech ma sherotze lachtoch min haom shel zetim shebbammaatan, bad o shene baddim betuma, kevan shello nigmera melachtan velo huchsheru:

Umechappe vetohora. kesheggamar likkach ma sheratza likkach, mechasse hammotar shebbammaatan betohora keillu huchshar, demoelet lekichato ma shellokeach lehachashiv et hammotar keillu nigmera melachtan:

Af mechappe vetuma. deaf hannishar lo huchshar, kevan shello nigmera melachtan vedato lehosif alehem. umihu im akar kol hazzetim shebbammaatan kede laasotan bevet habbad, hayu muchsharim levet hillel:
Rabbi yose omer chofer bekardummot. veoker kol hazzetim shebbammaatan:
Umolich levet habbad betuma. lefi shello huchsheru. vekardummot denakat, lirvuta, lefi shehen kele barzel umuchanim letumat met yoter mishshear kelim. vahalacha kevet hillel:

Mippene shehayu gannavim. kelomar, kevan dehinnicho naul umetzao patuach, vadday gannavim hayu sham ufetachuhu, vehay delo metammeinan leh, deemur nimlechu vehalchu lahen velo nagu bechol ma shebbabbayit. vahalacha kachachamim:
Hammanniach zetim bakkofesh. garsinan. vehu sal gadol shemmannichim bo zetim lichmor:
Sheyyimtonu. sheyyitrakkechu vetihye bahen lachluchit. veyesh sefarim sheggorsim bakkotesh, shemmannichim otam bammachteshet yamim rabbim kede sheyyeasu rafim verakkim veyihyu nochin lehikkatesh:
Hare ellu muchsharim. bammochal hayyotze mehen, shekkevar nigmera melachtan:
Bet hillel omrim en muchsharim. delo nigmera melachtan adayin:
Happotzea zetim. memaachan beyadayim mesoavot:

Timmean. deyadayim mesoavot poslot et hatteruma, vechol happosel et hatteruma metamme mashkin lihyot techilla. vehen muchsharim biftziato, denicha leh bammashke detayef alayhu, shemmittoch kach hen marbim taam:
Shezzippetah nachri. orcha lemirme vah chamra fureta, leabbore kutera dezifta:
Menaggevah. bemayim veefer:
Veshel etz. devaaya zefet tuva uvala chamra tefe:
Rabbi omer yenaggev. keshel even. veen halacha cherabbi:
Veshel cheres. ben lerabbi ben lerabbanan: af al pi shekkalaf hazzefet asur. decheres belo zifta bala leh chamra:
Ellu asurin veosrin bechol shehen. kol makom shennitarvu sham afillu echad beelef osrin et kullan:

Yen nesech. chavit achat beelef chaviyyot oser et kullan bahanaa. veen ken halacha, ella kidchatvinan shilhe ferek kol hatztzelamim, molich deme otah chavit leyam hammelach, vehashshear hakkol muttar bahanaa veasur bishtiyya:
Vaavoda zara. tzura sheavaduha, venitarva veelef tzurot sheenan avoda zara:
Veorot levuvin. dahave nammi issure hanaa, kidamrinan beferek en maamidin:
Vetzippore metzora vechulei‏ vechullin shennishchatu vaazara. issure hanaa hen. uveferek 2‏ dekiddushin parshinan lehu:

Usear nazir. deissure hanaa hu, dichtiv (Bamidbar 6) venatan al haesh asher tachat zevach hashshelamim. veim nitarva agudda shel sear nazir afillu veelef aguddot shel shear searot, kullan asurot bahanaa:
Ufeter chamor. asur bahanaa kol zeman shello nifda:

Uvasar bechalav. chatichat basar shennitbashshela vechalav venitarva veelef chatichot, oseret et kullan bahanaa. vesavar hay tanna dedavar sheddarko limmanot veissuro issur hanaa oser et taaravto bechol shehu. vechol hane dechashev bematnitin, davar sheddarko limmanot hu veissuran issur hanaa:
Hare ellu. limute issure hanaa sheen darkan limmanot, o sheddarkan limmanot veenan issure hanaa, sheenan osrin et taaravtan bechol shehen:
Vehalla chotev lo hitkabbalti mimmecha maot muttar. im habbayit patuach lirshut harabbim veyisreelim darim beotah hair, kidamrinan leel:

Aval im yirtze vechulei. dehashta have hayyayin mashkon etzel hannachri, hoil veyesh lo milva al hayyayin, asur, delo mirtat, desavar i chazu li vetavu li, amena didi hu. veaf al pi shemmafteach vechotam beyad yisrael, asur:
Hotziu lo. millishkat hakkelim:

Vechach hayta middatah. kemiddatah bachutz kach middatah bifnim, ma bachutz haya chofen bechafnav mammash velo bichli, kach bifnim keshemmeare hakketoret min hakkaf letoch chafnav lo haya meare bichli asuy kemiddat chafnav ella letoch chafnav mammash:
Natal et hammachta bimino. lefi shehi keveda vechamma vechaf hakketoret kalla hemenna, lechach machta bimino vechaf bismolo:
Haya mehallech bahechol. nichnas umehallech betochah lammaarav:

Leven shete happarochot. lefi shennistappeku bevayit sheni im hammechitztza hammavdelet ben hakkodesh uven kodesh hakkadashim shehayta bevayit rishon vehaya avyah amma, i otah amma kelifnim o kelachutz, lefichach asu shete parochot, achat chitzona veachat penimit, uvenehen avir amma, liklot benehen avir mekom hammechitztza:
Hachitzona ferufa min haddarom. rabbanan kaamri la, diflige aleh derabbi yose veamre vehivdila happarochet lachem bammishkan bilvad neemar.
Perufa. roshah kefula letzad hachitzon veneechezet bekeres shel zahav lihyot [petucha] min haddarom veomedet:
Mehallech benehen. nichnas bifrifat haddarom umehallech benehem ad shemmaggia lifrifat hatztzafon:

Higgia latztzafon. mishshennichnas letoch chalal bet kodesh hakkadashim hafach panav laddarom, lelech ad ben habbaddim shehu beemtza hechalal, shehabbaddim hayu arukkin ad happarochet, rosho echad lammaarav vehashsheni lo lammizrach, echad berosh haaron latztzafon veechad berosho laddarom:
Mehallech lismolo im happarochet. shehamehallech mitztzafon ledarom semolo lammizrach, vehapparochet hayta bammizrach, nimtza semolo im happarochet:
Ad shehu maggia laaron. limkom aron, velo laaron mammash, divvayit sheni lo haya sham aron:
Derech kenisato. shello haya mesev et panav latzet, ella yotze derech achorav ufanav laaron:

Umitpallel tefilla ketzara. vezo hi, yehi ratzon millefanecha Adonai‏ elohay, sheim shana zo shechuna, perush chamma, shettehe geshuma, velo yaade avid shultan middevet yehuda, velo yihyu ammecha yisrael tzerichim parnasa ze mizze velo meam acher, velo tikkanes lefanecha tefillat ovre derachim, perush mippene shehem mitpallelin shello yerdu geshamim:
Babbayit hachitzon. bahechol:
Shello lehaveit et yisrael. sheyyomru met hu:
Naged shema aved sheme. mi shennimshach shemo lemerachok mittoch serara verabbanut, mehera yeaved shemo, sheharabbanut mekabberet et bealeha. naged leshon meshicha. tirgum mishchu, negidu:
Udelo mosif. mi sheeno mosif al limmudo:
Yasef. yasuf mippiv ma shekkevar lamad veyishkach talmudo. veyesh sheggorsin yeasef, kelomar yeasef el ammav veyamut belo itto:
Udelo yalef. kashe middelo mosif, hilkach ketala chayyav, kelomar rauy hu sheyyaharguhu, kemo sheamru (fesachim mat) am haaretz muttar lekaro kedag, umiggabbo:

Udeishtammesh betaga. hammishtammesh bechitrah shel tora keadam hammishtammesh bechelav, chalaf veavar min haolam. taga bilshon yishmael keter. veyesh mefarshim, 404 rashe tevot talmid gavra acharina. sheasur laadam lehishtammesh betalmidim sheenan talmidav. vaani shamati, udeyishtammesh betaga, hammishtammesh bashshem hameforash, chalaf veavad, sheen lo chelek laolam habba:
Haochel. anavim:
Min hassallim umin hammashteach shel adama. distaman laachila nivtzeru. af al pi sheyyadav temeot vehaanavim notfim yayin laggat:

Hare haggat tehora. deotan tippin en lahem torat mashke, hoil velaachila nivtzeru velo nicha leh bemay detayef. aval haochel min heavit umin hammashteach shel alim, af al pi sheen haanavim mevukkaot veenan menattefot, im nafal mimmennu garger yechidi veen chotam leoto garger, dehaynu bammakom shehaoketz al pi haggarger yesh kemin chotam veoto chotam sotem pi haggarger sheen mashke yotze. ucheshenneekar haoketz im hachotam, mashke yotze, veaf al pi shennetalam leachlam yesh lo torat mashke, hoil umittechilla betzaram laggat, venitma oto mashke beyadav temeot, ucheshennafal laggat nitma. vehane mille keshennaga beyadav bimkom hachotam. aval im lo naga bimkom hachotam, lo nitma haggat, shehare lo nagu yadav bammashkim kede sheyyachazor hammashke vitamme haggat:
Naflu mimmennu anavim. kelomar eshkol shel anavim, shehaggargerim mechubbarim baeshkol veen mashke yotze, venitmeu beyadav temeot, dehuchsheru lefi shennivtzar laggat:
Uderachan bemakom hamufne. makom panuy baggat sheen sham kelum lo yayin velo anavim uderachuhu betohora:

Kabbetza mechuvvan tahor. haggat, deen ochel metamme keli, umisheyyatzat tippa rishona chaser leh mikkabbetza veen ochel metamme acherim befachot mikkabbetza, nimtza deen tuma letippa zo ella mechamat tuma shekkibbelah keshehayta ochel, hilkach hasheta nammi denaaset mashke en lah koach ella keochel. aval yoter mikkabbetza, tame, shehabbetza metammea tippa rishona kedin mashke, vechazra hattippa vetimmea et haggat, demashke metamme keli:
Shene seire. bemare. shenehem levanim o shenehem shechorim.

Uvekoma uvedamim. ditlata kerae ketivi. (Vayikra 16) umeet adat bene yisrael yikkach shene seirim. velakach et shene hasseirim. venatan aharon al shene hasseirim. vechevan disirim tere mashma, ma talmud lomar shene shene shene telata zimne, ella sheyyihyu shavim bemare uvekoma uvedamim:
Veyomar im shel shem met kulei. hachi mipparshah, im shel shem met yomar ze sheala alav haggoral lashshem yitkayyem tachtav. veim shel azazel met yomar ze [sheala] alav vechulei:

Vehashsheni. im shel azazel met veachshav yesh kan shenayim lashshem, echad shennishar mizzug rishon veechad mizzug sheni, uveechad mehen yitkapperu, vehashsheni yire. vechen im shel shem met vahare yesh kan shenayim laazazel, haechad yishtallach vehashsheni yire. vesheni shebbezug sheni hu sheyyire ad sheyyippol bo mum, vesheni shebbezug rishon hu sheyyikrav im hu shel shem, o yishtallach im hu shel azazel, sheen baale chayyim nidchin, veim era lahen sheat pesul adayin yecholin lehittakken kesheyyizdavveg lo acher:

Sheen chattat tzibbur meta. dechi gemire chattaot metot, beyachid gemire. useire yom hakkippurim chatteot tzibbur hen, dichtiv (Vayikra 16) umeet adat bene yisrael yikkach. vechattat meta hu shemmachnisin otah levayit echad umannichin otah sham ad shettamut:

Veod amar rabbi yehuda nishpach haddam. shel sair shel hashshem, yamut hammishtalleach, deha lo itavida mitzva dedam, uvechol haavodot hannaasot bevigde lavan ben bifnim ben bachutz chukka ketiv behu leakkev, vetzarich lehavi dam acher vei efshar ella behagerala, vechevan deit leh baale chayyim nidchin yamut hammishtalleach harishon:

Met hammishtalleach. af al gav deshilluach lo meakkev ledivre hakkol, dechi ketiv chukka leakkev addevarim shehakkohen ose bevigde lavan, lo al devarim hannaasim beyad ish itti, mikkol makom yalfinan mikkera dichtiv (sham) yoomad chay lifne Adonai‏ lechapper alav, ad ematay zakuk hammishtalleach laamod chay, ad sheat mattan damo shel chavero, ha im met kodem lachen en kapparat haddam kelum, lechach tzarich tashlumim. uvelo hagerala i efshar, vezakuk lishnayim, verishon yiddache, dehakkol modim bishchutim shennidchim:
Bechol yom. keshechote gechalim mimmaaracha sheniyya shel ketoret lehachenis al mizbeach happenimi liktoret shacharit vearvit:
Chote beshel kesef umeare beshel zahav. veeno chote beshel zahav, shechatiyyat haggechalim shocheket hakkeli umechassarto, vehattora chasa al mamonan shel yisrael:
Vehayyom chote veshel zahav. shello lehateriach al kohen gadol learot mikkeli el keli:
Keveda. shehaya dafnah ave:
Vehayyom kalla. shehaya dafnah dak:
Vehayyom arukka. kede shettehe zeroa shel kohen gadol mesayyato:
Vehayyom adom. mizzahav hakkaruy zehav parvayim, al shem sheddome ledam parim:
Peras. chatzi mane:

Dakka min haddakka. dichtiv (Vayikra 16) umelo chafnav ketoret sammim dakka, uma talmud lomar, vahalo kevar neemar (Shemot 30) veshachakta mimmenna hadek, ella lomar lecha shekketoret shel yom hakkippurim tehe dakka min haddakka:

Lo mippene sheeno rashshay. demahu detema haroe avoda achat eno rashshay lehannichah kede lelech lirot avoda acheret deen maavirin al hammitzvot, ureiyyat avoda mitzva hi mishshum berov am haderat melech, ka mashma lan delo meavar mitzva hu, kevan sheeno asuk bah:

Peras. leshon erech. beerkecha, metargeminan puresaneh. vehu ma sheadam noten lemi sheavad oto vehu eno chayyav baddin litten lo kelum, kemo ma sheyyitten adam livno katan o leishto o leavdo mippene korat ruach sheasu lo. vaafillu letikvat peras kaze lo yaavod adam et boro, ella meahava bilvad:

Vihi mora shamayim alechem. af al pi sheatta oved meahava avod gam ken miyyira. shehaoved meahava zariz bemitzvot ase, vehaoved miyyira nizhar mimmitzvot lo taase, venimtzet daavodato shelema. vechen amru chazal, avod meahava avod miyyira. avod meahava, sheim bata lisno da sheatta ohev veen ohev sone. avod miyyira, sheim bata livot da sheatta yare veen yare boet:

Heve mittalmidav shel aharon ohev shalom verodef shalom. pershu beavot derabbi natan, ketzad haya aharon ohev shalom, keshehaya roe shene bene adam mitkottim haya holech lechol echad mehem shello middaat chavero, veomer lo ree chavercha ech hu mitcharet umakke et atzmo al shechata lecha, vehu amar li sheavo elecha shettimchal lo, umittoch kach keshehayu pogim ze baze hayu menashshekim ze et ze. vechetzad haya mekarev et habberiyyot lattora, keshehaya yodea beadam sheavar avera haya mitchabber immo umare lo panim tzehubbot, vehaya oto adam mitbayyesh veomer illu haya yodea tzaddik ze maasay haraim kamma haya mitrachek mimmenni, umittoch kach haya chozer lammutav. hu shehannavi meid alav (Malachi 2:6) beshalom uvemishor halach itti verabbim heshiv meavon:
Legargeram. laasot mehen gargerim. kelomar laasot shekkol garger vegarger yityabbesh bachamma veyitnaggev:

Afillu hen rum amma. dichshennityabbeshu haelyonot, hattachtonot mazziot umitlachlechot bammashke, mikkol makom hoil vedato sheyyitnaggevu, enan muchsharim. veyesh mefarshim legargeran, lemattekan bachamma kede lesaftam bemelach uleachlan. ulefi sheen mitmattekin kullam bevat achat, mishshum hachi nakat legargeran, kelomar sheyyikkach haggargerim hammitmattekin rishon rishon veyochlem. vegorsin afillu hen rum amma hare ellu muchsharim, kelomar afillu shehen gevohim amma dehashta otan hattachtonot enan mitmattekot, hare ellu muchsharim bammashke hayyotze mehen, denicha leh sheyyazziu sham, dachazu laachila tefe:
Sheyyilku. sheyyitmaachu veyitpatztzeu:
Veatid lehaalotan laggag. achar kach lemattekan sham bachamma:
Netanan baggag sheyyiftechem. sheyyitbakkeu hazzetim veyimlechem:
Hare ellu muchsharim. dechol hane nicha leh bezeat hashshemen hanniflat:
Ad sheyyeshammer. sheyyetakken shomera legaggo. sukka mikkanim vekash sheosim berosh haggag lashevet sham lishmor:
Enan muchsharim. delo nicha leh bazzea sheyyotzet mehen:
Dulbeki. keli shemmannichin bo chosot vaashishot beochalin umashkin, umimmennu notlin umesimin al hashshulchan, veen echad min hamesubbin notel kelum min haddulpeki ella min hashshulchan:
Veim amar lo heve mozeg veshote. hoil vehirchiv lo harshut: af ma sheal haddulpeki asur. desamcha date venaga bechulleh:
Chaviyyot petuchot. hannimtzaot bevayit shehinnicho sham:
Kede sheyyiftach veyistom veyiggov. setama cherabban shimon ben gamliel dehilchata kevateh:
Yehi vetcha fatuach lirvacha. keveto shel avraham avinu alav hashshalom shehaya patuach learba ruchot haolam, kede shello yitztarchu haorchim lehakkif limtzo happetach:
Veyihyu aniyyim bene vetcha. velo yikne avadim leshammesho. mutav sheyyehanu yisrael minnechasav velo zera kenaan haarur:

Beishto amru. middekaamar im haishsha velo amar im ishsha, lamadnu shebbeishto amru. it dimfarshe, beishto nidda bilvad, shello yavo lide hergel avera. umiddivre hammishna nire, daafillu beishto tehora. vechen amru chazal (chagiga Adonai) maggid leadam ma secho, afillu sicha kalla shebben ish leishto maggidin lo bishat haddin. ella im ken tzarich lefayyesah lidvar mitzva, kegon rav desach vesachak veasa tzerachav:

Mikkan amru chachamim. rabbenu hakkadosh shessidder hammishnayot ketavah, middivre chacham ze sheamar veal tarbe sicha im haishsha lamdu chachamim lomar, kol zeman sheadam marbe sicha im haishsha gorem raa leatzmo. matzati katuv, kesheadam mesapper leishto korotav kach vechach era li im peloni, hi melammedto lecharcher riv, kegon korach shessipper leishto ma sheasa moshe shehenif et halleviyyim tenufa, veheviattu bidvareha lide machaloket. i nammi, mittoch shehu mesapper lah shechaverav ginnuhu uviyyeshuhu af hi mevazza oto belibbah, veze gorem raa leatzmo:
Uvotel middivre tora. shennimshach achar devarim betelim veeno osek battora:
Hizzaharu vedivrechem. shello tannichu makom lamminim litot bedivrechem:

Shemma tachuvu chovat galut. kelomar, af al pi shebbammakom sheattem bo en sham minim, yesh lachush shemma yigrom hachet vetitchayyevu galut, vetiglu lemakom sheyyesh sham anashim shemmarim panim battora shello kahalacha, vehem kinnuy lammayim haraim, veyavinu mittoch divrechem devarim sheenam hagunim, veyishtu hattalmidim habbaim acharechem meotam devarim divre minut veyamutu baavonam:

Venimtza shem shamayim mitchallel. sheyyishshaaru otan deot betelot baolam. kemo shekkara leantignos ish socho im tzadok uvaytos talmidav, sheamar lahem al tihyu kaavadim hameshammeshim et harav al menat lekabbel peras, veamru hem, efshar poel ose melacha kol hayyom vetoreach velaerev eno mekabbel peras. veyatzu leminut hem vetalmidehem, venikraim tzedokim uvaytosim ad hayyom:
Shennichnesa shello virshut. umirteta shello tittafes kegannav umemaheret latzet, veaf al pi shelletzorech beno o behemto shel baal habbayit nichnesa:
Ella sheasu hakkohanim keva. lihyot meshallechin oto, velo hayu bet din shel kohanim mannichin et yisrael leholicho:
Arsela. shem haish:
Hare mazon vahare mayim. lo hayu omrim lo kach ella kede sheyyitav libbo, shemmi sheyyesh lo pat besallo eno raev kemi sheen lo pat besallo, aval meolam lo hutzrach adam lechach:

Umelavvin oto missukka lesukka. shemmirushalayim vead sukka rishona mil, veeser sukkot, uven kol sukka vesukka mil, hare mirushalayim ad sukka acharona asara milin. nishar missukka acharona latztzuk shene milin, melavvin oto mil kemiddat techum shabbat, veomdim merachok veroin et maasav:

Haiggulim lazzaggim. iggul kemin rechayim gadol hayu mesimin al hazzagim leachar sheddarchu haanavim baregel, kede sheyyitmatztzu veyetze kol hayyayin hannishar bahen, umittoch kavdo vegadlo shel iggul ze tzerichim bene adam harebe lehaaloto al hatztzibbur shel hazzagin heasuy kemin tappuach ulehorido, lechach necheshav reshut harabbim letaher sefek tuma, mishshum derabbim metzuyin sham:
Kerem shellifne habbotzrim reshut hayyachid. sheyyerein bene adam likkanes sham, mippene shennitpas alav kegannav:
Achar habbotzrim reshut harabbim. sheyyesh reshut lechol adam likkanes:
Kele vet habbad shel gat. kelomar veshel gat. devet habbad leshemen, vegat leyayin:
Haekel. asuy kemin kuppa mesoreget keen reshet, veachar shessachatu hazzetim notnim haggefet beoto ekel, umannichim alav davar machbid lehotzi hannishar:
Menaggevan. vekodem lachen lo mehaneya tevila im nitmeu, ad sheyyetze mehen hammashke hattame shennidbak bahen:
Choltan. shofech alehen mayim rotchim veachar kach matbilan:
Beshibbolet hannahar. makom shehammayim rodfin, kede lehotzi hammashke hannidbak bahen. veen halacha kerabbi yose:
Nimtza al gabbe ferudim. leachar shettaka yated baom lehaferid haom lechamma chalakim perudim, uvechol gush vegush meelle hachalakim happerudim mehaom yesh zetim medubbakim:
Vehu nogea bechabbetza. sheim bata letzaref zetim shehashsheretz nogea bahen yesh bahen kabbetza:

Tame. kol haggush. af al gav deen haggush chibbur mishshettaka et hayyated baom lehaferidam, mikkol makom kevan deyesh begush ze zetim temein keshiur letamme acherim, dehaynu kabbetza, naasa chibbur letamme kol shear hazzetim shebbo:
Perudim al gabbe ferudim. sheyyesh gushim al gabbe gushim vehashsheretz al haggush haelyon:
Af al pi shehashsheretz nogea bechabbetza. shel oto gush:
En tame ella mekom maggao. shel sheretz, kelomar oto gush bilvad shehashsheretz naga bo. aval shear gushim, tehorim:
Nimtza. hashsheretz:
Ben hakkotel lazzetim tahor. velo chayshinan shemma haya al hazzetim:
Nimtza vaggag. hammaale zetim min hammaatan laggag, venimtza sheretz achar kach bazzetim sheal haggag:
Hammaatan tahor. kelomar zetim shebbammaatan tehorin, velo amrinan im hazzetim huva vehaya bammaatan:
Nimtza vammaatan. zetim sheheela baggag, temein, demikkodem sheheela hazzetim laggag haya hashsheretz bammaatan:
Nimtza saruf. vesheretz saruf lo metamme, dichtiv [vayyikra 11] bemotam, keen motam. ucheshennimtza saruf al gabbe zetim tehorim, lo chayshinan shemma naga bahen kodem shennisraf:
Mehuha. beged shennitcharech baesh venaasa kemin kure akkavish, veshuv eno mekabbel tuma:
Tehora. velo amrinan shemma tame haya mittechilla kodem shennitcharech:
Kishat metziatan. ben lehakel ben lehachemir:
Kevan shehishshikah lammikve. kevan shechibber katze echad min hammakkel bammikve, af al pi shello hitbilo kullo, taharu kol hammashkin temein shebberosho haacher, diktafres chibbur:
Ad sheyyatbil et kullah. dekasavre rabbanan ketafres eno chibbur:
Hannitztzok. killuach tzinnor habba millemala lematta bizkifa keammud:
Ketafres. mayim habbaim millemala lematta derech midron shel tel gavoah:
Umashke tofeach. veen bo tofeach al menat lehatepiach, sheen bo kol kach mashke sheim tafach bahen yado ala bah mashke sheyyuchal lehatepiach davar acher:

Eno chibbur lo lattuma. sheim mashkim telushin hen venaga tame battachton, haelyon tahor. vechen leinyan mashke tofeach, vaafillu bemakom chalak, im mashkin mikkan umashkin mikkan umashke tofeach beemtza, naga tame bemashke tofeach, mashkin shemmikkan umikkan tehorim af al pi shemmechubbarim lo:
Velo lattohora. kegon gumma sheen bah arbaim sea, venitztzok o mashke tofeach mechubbar legumma zo ulemikve kasher, eno chibbur, vehattovel begumma zo lo alta lo tevila:
Eshboren. makom amok shennikvu bo mayim:
Chibbur lattuma velattohora. veim nitmeu ketzatan nitmeu kullan. vechen im nitchabberu ketzat mehen lammikve vetaharu, taharu kullan:
Mishsheyare. mishshiyyure. shelleachar shemmetu kullan nishtayyera hakkabbala beyado. vehu haya kohen gadol achar ezra:
Hu haya omer. kelomar kach haya meraggela befumeh tamid. vechen kol rabbi peloni omer, hu haya omer, shebbemassechta zo, perushan haya ragil lomar ken tamid:
Haolam omed. lo nivra haolam ella bishvil shelosha devarim hallalu:
Al hattora. sheilmale lo kibbelu yisrael et hattora lo nivreu shamayim vaaretz, dichtiv (yirmeya log) im lo veriti yomam valayla chukkot shamayim vaaretz lo samti (shabbat pach.):

Veal haavoda. avodat hakkarbanot. shekkach shaninu bemassechet taanit (27:), sheilmale maamadot lo nitkayyemu shamayim vaaretz. umatzinu shebbishvil hakkarbanot shehikriv noach nishba [hakkadosh baruch hu] shello yavi mabbul laolam. hare shehaolam omed al hakkarbanot:
Veal gemilut chasadim. dichtiv (tehillim 89) olam chesed yibbane. ugemilut chasadim, hu lesammeach chatanim, ulenachem avelim, ulevakker cholim, velikbor metim, vechayyotze vaze:
Hazzolef et habbor. hammotzi yayin veshemen shebbabbor. umippene sheeno motzio kullo bevat achat ella meat meat, kare leh zolef:
Venimtza sheretz barishona. shehichnis chavit babbor umilleah, vechen sheniyya, vechen shelishit, veachar kach nimtza sheretz bechavit shemmille rishona:
Kullan temeot. demeharishona nitma kol ma shebbabbor, ben shehaya sheretz babbor ben shehaya bechavit:
Baacharona hi temea vechullan tehorot. demimmenna haya hashsheretz velo min habbor. vaafillu haya min habbor, shemma nafal babbor achar shennitmalleu kol harishonot:
Ematay bizman shehu zolef. keshehu machnis hechaviyyot atzman betoch habbor umemalle otan achat achat:
Aval haya zolef bemachatz. shehechaviyyot omdot chutz labbor, vehu memalle otan al yede hammachatz, vehu keli cheres heasuy lemalleot bo yayin:
Nimtza sheretz beachat mehen hi temea bilvad. deemur betoch hechavit haya hashsheretz velo babbor:

Ematay bizman shehu vodek. hammachatz vehechaviyyot. shebbedakan shello haya bahen sheretz kodem shennatan letocho shemen, aval lo haya mechasse lo habbor velo hechaviyyot kol shaa shehaya mevi hammachatz mizze laze, deemur bahalichato nafal hashsheretz bechavit. vechen mechasse velo bodek nammi shemma haya bechavit kodem lachen:

Aval haya vodek umechasse. shebbadak hechaviyyot, uvechol paam shehaya molich hammachatz mizze laze haya mechasse ben bor ben chavit, mimma nafshach sheretz haya babbor mittechillato, ben shennimtza bechavit, ben shennimtza babbor, ben shennimtza bammachatz:
